sayings.arabic: بِسْمِ الله اللّهُـمَّ إِنِّـي أَعـوذُ بِـكَ مِـنَ الْخُـبْثِ وَالْخَبائِث

transcription.bs: Bismillāhi, Allāhumme innī e‘ūḏu bike mine-l-ḫubṯi ve-l-ḫabā’iṯi.
transcription.en: [Bismillāhi] Allāhumma 'innī 'a`ūdhu bika minal-khubthi walkhabā'ith.

translation.bs: U ime Allaha, Allahu moj, prizivam Te protiv zla muških i ženskih šejtana.
translation.en: [In the Name of Allah]. O Allah, I seek protection in You from evil and the evil ones (or, from the evil male and female Jinn).

sayings.arabic: غُفْـرانَك

transcription.bs: Gufrāneke.
transcription.en: Ghufrānaka

translation.bs: Za oprost Te molim.
translation.en: I seek Your forgiveness.

sayings.arabic: بِسْمِ الله

transcription.bs: Bismillāh.
transcription.en: Bismillāhi

translation.bs: U ime Allaha.
translation.en: In the Name of Allah

sayings.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لا إِلَـهَ إِلاّ اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَريـكَ لَـهُ وَأَشْهَدُأَنَّ مُحَمّـداً عَبْـدُهُ وَرَسـولُـه

transcription.bs: Ešhedu en lā ilāhe illellāhu vaḥdehu lā šerīke lehu ve ešhedu enne Muḥammeden ‘abduhu ve resūluhu.
transcription.en: 'Ash-hadu 'an lā 'ilāha 'illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu wa 'ash-hadu 'anna Muḥammadan `abduhu wa Rasūluhu.

translation.bs: Svjedočim da nema boga osim Allaha i svjedočim da je Muhammed Njegov rob i Njegov Poslanik.
translation.en: I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner; and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and His Messenger.

sayings.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا، وَفِي لِسَانِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ فِي سَمْعِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ فِي بَصَرِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ مِنْ خَلْفِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ أَمَامِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ مِنْ فَوْقِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ تَحْتِي نُورًا، اللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِي نُورًا

transcription.bs: Allāhumme-dž‘al fī qalbī nūren, ve fī lisānī nūren, ve-dž‘al fī sem‘ī nūren, ve-dž‘al fī beṣarī nūren, ve-dž‘al min ḫalfī nūren ve min emāmī nūren, ve-dž‘al min fevqī nūren ve min taḥtī nūren. Allāhumme a‘ṭinī nūren.
transcription.en: Allahummaj'al fi qalbi nuran, wa fi lisani nuran waj'al fi sam'i nuran waj'al fi basari nuran waj'al min khalfi nuran wa min amami nuran waj'al min fawqi nuran wa min tahti nuran. Allahumma a'tini nura.

translation.bs: Allahu moj, podari mi u srce svjetlo i u jezik svjetlo, osvijetli mi sluh i vid, daruj mi svjetlo iza mene i ispred mene, podari mi iznad mene i ispod mene svjetlo. Allahu moj, svjetlo mi daruj.
translation.en: O Allah, place within my heart light, and upon my tongue light, and within my ears light, and within my eyes light, and place behind me light and in front of me light and above me light and beneath me light. O Allah, bestow upon me light.

sayings.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيمِ وَسُلْطَانِهِ الْقَدِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ. بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ. اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ

transcription.bs: E‘ūḏu billāhi-l-‘aẓīmi ve bi vedžhihi-l-kerīmi ve sulṭānihi-l-qadīmi mine-š-šejṭāni-r-radžīm. Bismillāh, ve-ṣ-ṣalātu ve-s-selāmu ‘alā Resūlillāh. Allāhumme-ftaḥ li ebvābe raḥmetike.
transcription.en: A‘ūdhu billāh-il ‘azhīm, wa bi-wajhihi-l-karīm, wa sultānihi-l-qadīm, min-ash-shaytān-ir-rajīm. Bismillāhi, was-salātu was-salāmu ‘ala rasūlillāh. Allāhumma iftah li abwāba rahmatik.

translation.bs: Sklanjam se u okrilje Velikog Allaha, pred Njegovo lice časno, Njegovu vlast pravječnu, pred prokletim šejtanom. U ime Allaha, blagoslovi i spas i mir Njegovu Poslaniku. Allahu moj, otvori mi vrata milosti Tvoje.
translation.en: I take refuge with Allah, The Supreme and with His Noble Face, and His eternal authority from the accursed devil. In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me.

sayings.arabic: بِسمِ الله وَالصّلاةُ وَالسّلامُ عَلى رَسولِ الله، اللّهُـمَّ إِنّـي أَسْأَلُكَ مِـنْ فَضْـلِك، اللّهُـمَّ اعصِمْنـي مِنَ الشَّيْـطانِ الرَّجـيم

transcription.bs: Bismillāhi ve-ṣ-ṣalātu ve-s-selāmu ‘alā Resūlillāhi, Allāhumme innī es’eluke min faḍlike, Allāhumme-‘ṣimnī mine-š-šejṭāni-r-radžīm.
transcription.en: Bismillāhi waṣṣalātu wassalāmu 'alā Rasūlillāhi, Allāhumma 'innī 'as'aluka min faḍlika, Allāhumma`ṣimnī min ash-shaytānir-rajīm.

translation.bs: U ime Allaha, blagoslov i mir i spas Allahovu Poslaniku. Allahu moj, molim Ti se da me obaspeš dobrom. Allahu moj, zaštiti me od prokletog šejtana.
translation.en: In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, I ask You from Your favour. O Allah, guard me from the accursed devil.

sayings.arabic: حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ، وَحَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ

instructions.bs: Ponavljati riječi ezana za mujezinom, osim ova dva poziva:
instructions.en: The words of the adhan are repeated after the caller, except these two calls:

transcription.bs: Hajje ‘ale-ṣ-ṣalāh, hajje ‘ale-l-felāḥ.
transcription.en: Hayya 'alas-Salāh, hayya 'alal-Falāh.

translation.bs: Dođite na namaz, dođite na spas.
translation.en: Hasten to prayer, hasten to salvation.

sayings.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ

instructions.bs: Na svaki od ova dva poziva odgovoriti ovim riječima:
instructions.en: Each of these two calls is answered with these words:

transcription.bs: Lā ḥavle ve lā quvvete illā billāh.
transcription.en: Lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata 'illā billāh.

translation.bs: Nema snage niti moći osim Allahove (pomoći i moći).
translation.en: There is no might and no power except by Allah.

sayings.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدّعْـوَةِ التّـامَّة وَالصّلاةِ القَـائِمَة آتِ محَـمَّداً الوَسيـلةَ وَالْفَضـيلَة وَابْعَـثْه مَقـامـاً مَحـموداً الَّذي وَعَـدْتَه

instructions.bs: Nakon ezana proučiti salavat na Poslanika ﷺ, pa ovu dovu.
instructions.en: After the adhan, blessings are sent upon the Prophet ﷺ, followed by this supplication.

transcription.bs: Allāhumme rabbe hāḏihi-d-da‘veti-t-tāmmeti ve-ṣ-ṣalāti-l-qā’imeti āti Muḥammedeni-l-vesīlete ve-l-faḍīlete ve-b‘aṯhu meqāmen maḥmūdeni-l-leḏī ve‘adtehu.
transcription.en: Allāhumma rabba hādhihi 'd-da'wati 't-tāmmah waṣ-ṣalāti 'l-qā'imah, 'āti Muhammadani 'l-wasīlata walfaḍīlata, wab 'ath-hu maqāma 'm-mahmūdani 'l-ladhī wa`adtahu.

translation.bs: Allahu moj, Gospodaru ovog cjelovitog poziva, podari Muhammedu poseban stepen u Džennetu i svako dobro, te uzdigni ga na uzvišeno mjesto koje si mu obećao.
translation.en: O Allah , Lord of this perfect call and established prayer. Grant Muhammad the intercession and favor, and raise him to the honored station You have promised him.

sayings.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ

instructions.bs: Proučiti nakon početnog tekbira, prije učenja Kur’ana u namazu.
instructions.en: This is recited after the opening takbir, before reciting the Quran in prayer.

transcription.bs: Subḥāneke-llāhumme ve bi ḥamdike ve tebāreke-smuke ve te‘ālā džedduke ve lā ilāhe gajruke.
transcription.en: Subḥānaka Allāhumma wa biḥamdika, wa tabāraka 'smuka, wa ta'ālā jadduka, wa lā 'ilāha ghayruk.

translation.bs: Tebi pripada slava, Allahu moj, i uvijek si hvaljen. Blagoslovljeno je Tvoje Ime, uzvišena je Tvoja veličina i nema boga osim Tebe.
translation.en: Glory is to You O Allah, and praise. Blessed is Your Name and Exalted is Your Majesty. There is none worthy of worship but You.

sayings.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ

instructions.bs: Na pregibanju proučiti 3 puta.
instructions.en: This is recited 3 times while bowing in prayer.

transcription.bs: Subḥāne Rabije-l-‘aẓīm.
transcription.en: Subḥāna Rabbiyal-‘Aẓīm.

translation.bs: Neka si slavljen, Gospodaru moj Veliki.
translation.en: Glory to my Lord the Exalted.

sayings.arabic: سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ

transcription.bs: Semi‘allāhu limen ḥamideh.
transcription.en: Sami‘allāhu liman ḥamidah.

translation.bs: Čuo Allah onoga ko Ga hvali.
translation.en: Allah hears whoever praises Him.

sayings.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ

transcription.bs: Rabbenā ve leke-l-ḥamdu ḥamden keṯīren, ṭajjiben, mubāreken fīhi.
transcription.en: Rabbanā wa lakal-ḥamd, ḥamdan kathīran ṭayyiban mubārakan fīh.

translation.bs: Gospodaru naš, Tebi hvala, beskonačna hvala, lijepa hvala, u kojoj je svaki blagoslov.
translation.en: Our Lord, praise is Yours, abundant, good and blessed praise.

sayings.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْأَعْلَى

instructions.bs: Na sedždi proučiti 3 puta.
instructions.en: This is recited 3 times while prostrating in prayer.

transcription.bs: Subḥāne Rabbije-l-‘alā.
transcription.en: Subḥāna Rabbiya ‘l-a‘lā.

translation.bs: Neka si slavljen, moj najviši Gospodaru.
translation.en: Glory is to my Lord, the Most High.

sayings.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَاجْبُرْنِي وَعَافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي وَارْفَعْنِي

transcription.bs: Allāhumme-gfir lī, verḥamnī vehdinī vedžburnī, ve ‘āfinī verzuqnī verfa‘nī.
transcription.en: Allāhumma’ghfir lī, war’ḥamnī, wahdinī, wajburnī, wa ‘āfinī, warzuqnī, warfa‘nī.

translation.bs: Allahu moj, oprosti mi i smiluj se, uputi me i učini zadovoljnim (bogatim), sačuvaj me, nafaku mi daj i uzdigni me.
translation.en: O Allah forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, support me, protect me, provide for me, and elevate me.

sayings.arabic: التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ. أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ

transcription.bs: Etteḥijjātu lillāhi ve-ṣ-ṣalevātu ve-ṭ-ṭajjibātu, es-selāmu ‘alejke ejjuhe-n-nebijju ve raḥmetullāhi ve berekātuhu, es-selāmu ‘alejnā ve ‘alā ‘ibādillāhi-ṣ-ṣāliḥīn. Ešhedu en lā ilāhe illellāhu ve ešhedu enne Muḥammeden ‘abduhu ve Resūluhu.
transcription.en: Attaḥiyyātu lillāhi waṣṣalawātu, waṭṭayyibāt, assalāmu ‘alayka ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa raḥmatullāhi wa barakātuh, assalāmu ‘alaynā wa ‘alā ‘ibādillāhiṣ-ṣāliḥīn. Ash-hadu an lā ilāha illallāh wa ash-hadu anna Muḥammadan ‘abduhu wa rasūluh.

translation.bs: Najljepši selami, salavati i pohvale Allahu; selam tebi, Vjerovjesniče, i Allahova milost i Njegov blagoslov; selam nama i dobrim Allahovim robovima. Svjedočim da nema boga osim Allaha i svjedočim da je Muhammed Njegov rob i Njegov Poslanik.
translation.en: All greetings of humility are for Allah, and all prayers and goodness. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous slaves of Allah. I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and His Messenger.

title.en: Blessings upon the Prophet after tashahhud

sayings.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ. اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ

transcription.bs: Allāhumme ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammedin ve ‘alā āli Muḥammed, kemā ṣallejte ‘alā Ibrāhīme ve ‘alā āli Ibrāhīme, inneke ḥamīdun medžīd. Allāhumme bārik ‘alā Muḥammedin ve ‘alā āli Muḥammed kemā bārekte ‘alā Ibrāhīme ve ‘alā āli Ibrāhīme inneke ḥamīdun medžīd.
transcription.en: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli Muḥammadin, kamā ṣallayta ‘alā Ibrāhīma wa ‘alā āli Ibrāhīma, innaka ḥamīdum-majīd. Allāhumma bārik ‘alā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli Muḥammadin, kamā bārakta ‘alā Ibrāhīma wa ‘alā āli Ibrāhīma, innaka ḥamīdum-majīd.

translation.bs: Allahu moj, smiluj se (donesi salavat) Muhammedu, sallallahu alejhi ve sellem, i njegovom potomstvu kao što si se smilovao Ibrahimu, alejhis-selam, i njegovom potomstvu. Zaista si Ti hvaljen i slavljen. Allahu moj, blagoslovi Muhammeda, sallallahu alejhi ve sellem, i njegovo potomstvo kao što si blagoslovio Ibrahima, a.s., i njegovo potomstvo. Doista si Ti hvaljen i slavljen.
translation.en: O Allah, bestow Your favor on Muhammad and on the family of Muhammad as You have bestowed Your favor on Ibrahim and on the family of Ibrahim, You are Praiseworthy, Most Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You have blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim, You are Praiseworthy, Most Glorious.

title.bs: Dova poslije završnog tešehhuda, prije selama
title.en: After the final tashahhud, before salam

sayings.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ

transcription.bs: Allāhumme innī e‘ūḏu bike min ‘aḏābi-l-qabri ve e‘ūḏu bike min fitneti-l-mesīḥi-d-dedždžāli, ve e‘ūḏu bike min fitneti-l-maḥjā ve-l-memāt. Allāhumme innī e‘ūḏu bike mine-l-me’ṯemi ve-l-magrem.
transcription.en: Allāhumma innī a‘ūdhu bika min ‘adhābi ‘l-qabr, wa a‘ūdhu bika min fitnati ‘l-masīḥid-dajjāl, wa a‘ūdhu bika min fitnati ‘l-maḥyā wa ‘l-mamāt. Allāhumma innī a‘ūdhu bika mina ‘l-ma’thami wa ‘l-maghram.

translation.bs: Allahu, sklanjam se u okrilje Tvoje pred kaburskom kaznom i pred fitnelukom Mesiha Dedžala, te pred fitnelukom ovog i budućeg svijeta. Allahu, utječem Ti se od grijeha i duga koji se ne može vratiti.
translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, and I seek refuge in You from the trial of the False Messiah, and I seek refuge in You from the trials of life and death. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from sin and from debt.

sayings.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ

instructions.bs: Nakon selama proučiti 3 puta.
instructions.en: This is recited 3 times after the salam.

transcription.bs: Estagfirullāhe.
transcription.en: Astaghfirullāh.

translation.bs: Allaha za oprost molim.
translation.en: I seek the forgiveness of Allah.

sayings.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ

transcription.bs: Allāhumme Ente-s-Selāmu ve minke-s-Selāmu, tebārekte jā ḏe-l-dželāli ve-l-ikrām.
transcription.en: Allāhumma antas-salām, wa minkas-salām, tabārakta yā dhal-Jalāli wal-'Ikrām.

translation.bs: Allahu, Ti si Es-Selam i od Tebe je selam, blagodaran si Ti, Koji posjeduješ veličinu i plemenitost.
translation.en: O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, O Owner of majesty and honor.

sayings.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ

transcription.bs: Lā ilāhe illellāhu vaḥdehu lā šerīke leh, lehu-l-mulku ve lehu-l-ḥamdu ve huve ‘alā kulli šej’in qadīr. Allāhumme lā māni‘a limā e‘ṭajte ve lā mu‘ṭije limā mena‘te, ve lā jenfe‘u ḏe-l-džeddi minke-l-džeddu.
transcription.en: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa ‘alā kulli shay’in qadīr. Allāhumma lā māni‘a limā a‘ṭayta, wa lā mu‘ṭiya limā mana‘ta, wa lā yanfa‘u dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd.

translation.bs: Nema boga osim Allaha, Jedinoga, Koji druga nema. Njemu pripada sva vlast i On nad svakom stvari ima moć. Allahu, niko ne može spriječiti ono što si Ti dao, a niti dati ono što Ti ne daješ. Nikome ko posjeduje moć (bogatstvo, porijeklo) neće protiv Tebe koristiti njegova moć.
translation.en: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone. He has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is Able to do all things. O Allah, there is none who can withhold what You give, and none may give what You have withheld, and the might of the mighty person cannot benefit him against You.

sayings.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ

instructions.bs: Svaki od ova 3 zikra proučiti 33 puta.
instructions.en: Each of these 3 phrases is recited 33 times.

transcription.bs: Subḥānallāhi. Ve-l-ḥamdu lillāhi. Vallāhu ekber.
transcription.en: Subḥānallāh. Wal-ḥamdu lillāh. Wallāhu akbar.

translation.bs: Slava Allahu. Svaka Mu hvala. Allah je najveći.
translation.en: Glory is to Allah. Praise is to Allah. Allah is the Most Great.

sayings.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ. قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ. اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ. لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ. وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ

instructions.bs: Suru El-Ihlas proučiti 3 puta poslije sabaha i akšama, a jednom poslije podne, ikindije i jacije.
instructions.en: Al-Ikhlas is recited 3 times after Fajr and Maghrib, and once after Dhuhr, Asr and Isha.

transcription.bs: Bismillāhi-r-Raḥmāni-r-Raḥīm. Qul huvallāhu eḥad. Allāhu-ṣ-Ṣamed. Lem jelid ve lem jūled. Ve lem jekun lehu kufuven eḥad.
transcription.en: Bismillāhir-Raḥmānir-Raḥīm. Qul huwallāhu aḥad. Allāhuṣ-ṣamad. Lam yalid wa lam yūlad. Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan aḥad.

translation.bs: U ime Allaha, Milostivog, Samilosnog. Reci: On je Allah, Jedini. Allah je utočište svakom. Nije rodio niti je rođen, i niko Mu nije ravan.
translation.en: In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate. Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah is the One upon whom all depend. He neither begets nor was born, and none is equal to Him.

sayings.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ. قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ. مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ. وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ. وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ. وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ

instructions.bs: Suru El-Felek proučiti 3 puta poslije sabaha i akšama, a jednom poslije podne, ikindije i jacije.
instructions.en: Al-Falaq is recited 3 times after Fajr and Maghrib, and once after Dhuhr, Asr and Isha.

transcription.bs: Bismillāhi-r-Raḥmāni-r-Raḥīm. Qul e‘ūḏu bi Rabbi-l-feleq. Min šerri mā ḫaleq. Ve min šerri gāsiqin iḏā veqab. Ve min šerri-n-neffāṯāti fī-l-‘uqad. Ve min šerri ḥāsidin iḏā ḥased.
transcription.en: Bismillāhir-Raḥmānir-Raḥīm. Qul a‘ūdhu birabbil-falaq. Min sharri mā khalaq. Wa min sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffāthāti fil-‘uqad. Wa min sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasad.

translation.bs: U ime Allaha, Milostivog, Samilosnog. Reci: Tražim zaštitu Gospodara svitanja od zla onoga što je stvorio, od zla noći kada se spusti, od zla onih koji pušu u čvorove i od zla zavidnika kada zavidi.
translation.en: In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate. Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak from the evil of what He created, from the evil of darkness as it settles, from the evil of those who blow on knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.

sayings.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ. قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ. مَلِكِ النَّاسِ. إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ. مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ. الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ. مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ

instructions.bs: Suru En-Nas proučiti 3 puta poslije sabaha i akšama, a jednom poslije podne, ikindije i jacije.
instructions.en: An-Nas is recited 3 times after Fajr and Maghrib, and once after Dhuhr, Asr and Isha.

transcription.bs: Bismillāhi-r-Raḥmāni-r-Raḥīm. Qul e‘ūḏu bi Rabbi-n-nās. Meliki-n-nās. Ilāhi-n-nās. Min šerri-l-vesvāsi-l-ḫannās. Elleḏī juvesvisu fī ṣudūri-n-nās. Mine-l-džinneti ve-n-nās.
transcription.en: Bismillāhir-Raḥmānir-Raḥīm. Qul a‘ūdhu birabbin-nās. Malikin-nās. Ilāhin-nās. Min sharril-waswāsil-khannās. Alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūrin-nās. Minal-jinnati wan-nās.

translation.bs: U ime Allaha, Milostivog, Samilosnog. Reci: Tražim zaštitu Gospodara ljudi, Vladara ljudi, Boga ljudi, od zla šejtana koji se prikrada i povlači, koji unosi zle misli u srca ljudi, bio on od džina ili od ljudi.
translation.en: In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate. Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the whisperer who withdraws, who whispers into the hearts of mankind, from among jinn and people.

sayings.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ

transcription.bs: Allāhu lā ilāhe illā Huve-l-Ḥajju-l-Qajjūm. Lā te’ḫuḏuhū sinetun ve lā nevm. Lehū mā fī-s-semāvāti ve mā fī-l-erḍ. Men ḏā-lleḏī ješfe‘u ‘indehū illā bi-iḏnih. Ja‘lemu mā bejne ejdīhim ve mā ḫalfehum, ve lā juḥīṭūne bi šej’in min ‘ilmihī illā bi mā šā’e. Vesi‘a kursijjuhu-s-semāvāti ve-l-erḍa ve lā je’ūduhū ḥifẓuhumā ve Huve-l-‘Alijju-l-‘Aẓīm.
transcription.en: Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwa al-Ḥayyul-Qayyūm. Lā ta’khudhuhu sinatun wa lā nawm. Lahu mā fis-samāwāti wa mā fil-arḍ. Man dhal-ladhī yashfa‘u ‘indahu illā bi-idhnih. Ya‘lamu mā bayna aydīhim wa mā khalfahum, wa lā yuḥīṭūna bishay’in min ‘ilmihi illā bimā shā’. Wasi‘a kursiyyuhus-samāwāti wal-arḍa wa lā ya’ūduhu ḥifẓuhumā wa huwal-‘Aliyyul-‘Aẓīm.

translation.bs: Allah je, nema boga osim Njega, Živi i Vječni. Ne obuzima Ga ni drijemež ni san. Njemu pripada sve na nebesima i na Zemlji. Ko se može kod Njega zauzimati bez Njegovog dopuštenja? On zna šta je bilo prije njih i šta će biti poslije njih, a od Njegovog znanja oni obuhvataju samo ono što On želi. Njegova Kursija obuhvata nebesa i Zemlju i Njemu nije teško da ih čuva. On je Svevišnji, Veličanstveni.
translation.en: Allah: there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. Everything in the heavens and on earth belongs to Him. Who can intercede with Him without His permission? He knows what lies before them and what lies behind them, and they encompass only what He wills of His knowledge. His Kursi encompasses the heavens and the earth, and guarding them does not tire Him. He is the Most High, the Most Great.

sayings.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

instructions.bs: Poslije sabaha i akšama proučiti 10 puta.
instructions.en: This is recited 10 times after Fajr and Maghrib.

transcription.bs: Lā ilāhe illellāhu vaḥdehu lā šerīke leh, lehu-l-mulku ve lehu-l-ḥamdu, juḥjī ve jumītu ve huve ‘alā kulli šej’in qadīr.
transcription.en: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamd, yuḥyī wa yumīt, wa huwa ‘alā kulli shay’in qadīr.

translation.bs: Nema boga osim Allaha, Jedinoga, Koji druga nema. Njemu pripada sva vlast i zahvalnost. On oživljava i usmrćuje, i On nad svim ima moć.
translation.en: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise. He gives life and causes death, and He has power over all things.

sayings.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا

instructions.bs: Proučiti nakon predaje selama sabahskog farza.
instructions.en: This is recited after the salam of the obligatory Fajr prayer.

transcription.bs: Allāhumme innī es’eluke ‘ilmen nāfi‘an ve rizqan ṭajjiben ve ‘amelen muteqabbelen.
transcription.en: Allāhumma innī as’aluka ‘ilman nāfi‘an, wa rizqan ṭayyiban, wa ‘amalan mutaqabbalan.

translation.bs: Allahu, od Tebe molim korisno znanje, lijepu nafaku i djelo prihvaćeno kod Tebe.
translation.en: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and deeds that are accepted.

sayings.arabic: سَجَدَ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ، وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ بِحَوْلِهِ وَقُوَّتِهِ، فَتَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ

transcription.bs: Sedžede vedžhi li-l-leḏi ḫaleqahū ve šeqqa sem‘ahū ve beṣarehū, bi ḥavlihī ve quvvetihī. Fe tebārekellāhu aḥsenu-l-ḫāliqin.
transcription.en: Sajada wajhiya lilladhī khalaqahu, wa shaqqa sam‘ahu wa baṣarahu biḥawlihi wa quwwatihi. Fatabārakallāhu aḥsanul-khāliqīn.

translation.bs: Sedždu čini lice moje Onome Koji ga stvori i na njemu oblikova sluh i vid Svojom moći i snagom. Blagoslovljen neka je Allah, najbolji Stvaratelj.
translation.en: I have prostrated my face to the One Who created it, and gave it hearing and sight by His might and His power. Glory is to Allah, the Best of creators.

sayings.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي، فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي، ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي، فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ، وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ، ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ.

instructions.bs: Pri donošenju odluke klanjati 2 rekata dobrovoljnog namaza, pa proučiti ovu dovu.
instructions.en: When making a decision, 2 rak‘ahs of voluntary prayer are offered, followed by this supplication.

transcription.bs: Allāhumme innī este’ḫiruke bi ‘ilmike, ve estaqdiruke bi qudretike ve es’eluke min faḍlike-l-‘aẓīmi, fe inneke taqdiru ve lā aqdiru, ve ta‘lemu ve lā a‘lemu, ve Ente ‘Allāmu-l-gujūb. Allāhumme in kunte ta‘lemu enne hāḏe-l-emre (spomenuti o čemu se radi) ḫajrun lī fī dīnī ve me‘āšī ve ‘āqibeti emrī (ili je rekao: ‘ādžilihi ve ādžilihi), faqdirhu lī ve jessirhu lī, tumme bārik lī fīhi, ve in kunte ta‘lemu enne hāḏe-l-emre (spomenuti o čemu se radi) šerrun lī fī dīnī ve me‘āšī ve ‘āqibeti emrī (ili je rekao: ‘ādžilihi ve ādžilihi), faṣrifhu ‘annī, va-ṣrifnī ‘anhu va-qdir lije-l-ḫajre ḥajtu kāne, tumme erḍinī bihī.
transcription.en: Allāhumma innī astakhīruka bi ‘ilmik, wa astaqdiruka bi qudratik, wa as’aluka min faḍlika-l-‘aẓīm. Fa’innaka taqdiru wa lā aqdir, wa ta‘lamu wa lā a‘lam, wa anta ‘allāmu-l-ghuyūb. Allāhumma in kunta ta‘lamu anna hādha-l-amra (mention the matter) khayrun lī fī dīnī wa ma‘āshī wa ‘āqibati amrī (or: ‘ājilihi wa ājilihi), faqdurhu lī wa yassirhu lī, thumma bārik lī fīh. Wa in kunta ta‘lamu anna hādha-l-amra (mention the matter) sharrun lī fī dīnī wa ma‘āshī wa ‘āqibati amrī (or: ‘ājilihi wa ājilihi), faṣrifhu ‘annī waṣrifnī ‘anh, waqdur liya-l-khayra ḥaythu kān, thumma arḍinī bih.

translation.bs: Allahu, Tebe pitam za odgovor (rješenje) pomoću Tvoga znanja, i od Tebe pomoć tražim Tvojom moći. Molim Te za Tvoju veliku dobrotu, jer Ti to možeš, a ja ne mogu, i jer Ti to znaš, a ja ne znam. Ti si Jedini znalac tajnog. Allahu, ako je ovo (spomenuti o čemu se radi) dobro za mene, moju vjeru i moj život, i moju smrt (ili je rekao: za moj život na ovom i na onome svijetu), omogući da se dogodi, i olakšaj mi, zatim me blagoslovi tim. A ako znaš da će u ovome (djelu, događaju) (spomenuti o čemu se radi) biti zlo za mene, vjeru moju i život i moju smrt (ili je rekao: za moj život na ovom i na onome svijetu), otkloni ga od mene i mene sačuvaj od njega. Odredi mi u tome dobro gdjegod ono bilo, zatim me učini zadovoljnim s tim.
translation.en: O Allah, I seek Your guidance through Your knowledge and Your help through Your power, and I ask for Your great bounty. You are able and I am not; You know and I do not, and You know all that is unseen. If You know this matter (mention the matter) is good for my faith, my livelihood and the outcome of my affairs (or: in this life and the afterlife), decree it for me, make it easy and bless it for me. If You know this matter (mention the matter) is bad for my faith, my livelihood and the outcome of my affairs (or: in this life and the afterlife), turn it away from me and turn me away from it. Decree good for me wherever it is, then make me content with it.

sayings.arabic: ذَهَـبَ الظَّمَـأُ، وَابْتَلَّـتِ العُـروق، وَثَبَـتَ الأجْـرُ إِنْ شـاءَ الله

transcription.bs: Ḏehebe-ẓ-ẓama’u, vebtelleti-l-‘urūqu, ve ṯebete-l-edžru, in šā’e-llāhu.
transcription.en: Dhahabaẓ-ẓama', wabtallati ‘l-`urūq, wa thabata ‘l-'ajru in shā Allāh.

translation.bs: Nestala je žeđ, natopile se žile, a nagrada je osigurana, ako Allah htjedne.
translation.en: The thirst is gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.

sayings.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ

transcription.bs: Bismillāhi.
transcription.en: Bismillāhi.

translation.bs: U ime Allaha.
translation.en: With the Name of Allah.

title.bs: Dova kada se sjetimo da smo počeli jesti
title.en: When we remember that we started eating

sayings.arabic: بسمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ

transcription.bs: Bismillāhi fī evvelihi ve āḫirihi.
transcription.en: Bismillāhi fī awwalihi wa ākhirih.

translation.bs: U ime Allaha u početku i kraju jela.
translation.en: With the Name of Allah, in the beginning, and in the end.

sayings.arabic: الْحَمْـدُ للهِ الَّذي أَطْعَمَنـي هـذا وَرَزَقَنـيهِ مِنْ غَـيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلا قُوَّة

transcription.bs: El-ḥamdu li-llāhi-l-leḏī eṭ‘amenī hāḏā ve rezaqanīhi min gajri ḥavlin minnī ve lā quvvetin.
transcription.en: Alhamdu lillāhi ‘l-ladhī aṭ`amanī hādhā, wa razaqanīhi min ghayri ḥawlin minnī wa lā quwwah.

translation.bs: Hvala Allahu, Koji me nahrani i opskrbi bez moje snage i moći.
translation.en: Praise is to Allah Who has given me this food, and sustained me with it though I was unable to do it and powerless.

title.en: Of the guest for the host

sayings.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ بارِكْ لَهُمْ فيما رَزَقْـتَهُم، وَاغْفِـرْ لَهُـمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ

transcription.bs: Allāhumme bārik lehum fīmā rezaqtehum, vagfir lehum verḥamhum.
transcription.en: Allāhumma bārik lahum fī mā razaqtahum, wagh’fir lahum warḥamhum.

translation.bs: Allahu, blagoslovi im ono čime si ih opskrbio, oprosti im i smiluj im se.
translation.en: O Allah, bless them in what You have provided for them, and forgive them and have mercy on them.

title.en: To one who intends to give food or drink

sayings.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَن أَطْعَمَني، وَاسْقِ مَن سقاني

transcription.bs: Allāhumme aṭ‘im men aṭ‘amenī ve-sqi men seqānī.
transcription.en: Allāhumma aṭ`im man aṭ`amanī wasqi man saqānī.

translation.bs: Allahu, nahrani onoga ko je mene nahranio i napoji onoga ko je mene napojio.
translation.en: O Allah, feed the one who has fed me, and give drink to the one who has given me drink.

title.en: When breaking fast in someone’s home

sayings.arabic: أَفْطَـرَ عِنْدَكُم الصّـائِمونَ وَأَكَلَ طَعامَـكُمُ الأبْـرار، وَصَلَّـتْ عَلَـيْكُمُ الملائِكَـة

transcription.bs: Efṭara ‘indekumu-ṣ-ṣā’imūne ve ekele ṭa‘āmekumu-l-ebrāru, ve ṣallet ‘alejkumu-l-melā’iketu.
transcription.en: Afṭara `indakumuṣ-ṣā'imūn, wa akala ṭa`āmakumu ‘l-'abrār, wa ṣallat `alaykumu ‘l-malā'ikah.

translation.bs: Postači kod vas iftarili, dobri jeli i meleki na vas salavate donosili.
translation.en: With you, those who are fasting have broken their fast, you have fed those who are righteous, and the angels recite their prayers upon you.

sayings.arabic: إِنِّي صَائِمٌ، إِنِّي صَائِمٌ

transcription.bs: Innī ṣā’imun, innī ṣā’imun.
transcription.en: Innī ṣā'im, innī ṣā'im.

translation.bs: Ja postim, zaista, ja postim.
translation.en: I am fasting. I am fasting.

sayings.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ أَسْـلَمْتُ نَفْـسي إِلَـيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْـتُ أَمْـري إِلَـيْكَ، وَوَجَّـهْتُ وَجْـهي إِلَـيْكَ، وَأَلْـجَـاْتُ ظَهـري إِلَـيْكَ، رَغْبَـةً وَرَهْـبَةً إِلَـيْكَ، لا مَلْجَـأَ وَلا مَنْـجـا مِنْـكَ إِلاّ إِلَـيْكَ، آمَنْـتُ بِكِتـابِكَ الّـذي أَنْزَلْـتَ وَبِنَبِـيِّـكَ الّـذي أَرْسَلْـت

instructions.bs: Prije spavanja uzeti abdest kao za namaz, leći na desni bok i proučiti ovu dovu.
instructions.en: Before sleeping, this supplication is recited after performing ablution as for prayer and lying on the right side.

transcription.bs: Allāhumme eslemtu nefsī ilejke ve fevvaḍtu emrī ilejke ve vedždžehtu vedžhī ilejke ve eldže’tu ẓahrī ilejke ragbeten ve rehbeten ilejke, lā meldže’e ve lā mendžā minke illā ilejke. Āmentu bi Kitābike-l-leḏī enzelte ve bi Nebijjike-l-leḏī erselte.
transcription.en: Allāhumma aslamtu nafsī ilayk, wa fawwaḍtu amrī ilayk, wa wajjahtu wajhī ilayk, wa alja'tu ẓahrī ilayk, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayk, lā malja'a wa la manjā minka illā ilayk, āmantu bikitābika ‘l-ladhī anzalt, wa bi-nabiyyika ‘l-ladhī arsalt.

translation.bs: Allahu, Tebi predadoh svoju dušu, i oporučih svoje stanje, i upravih lice svoje, i prepustih (sklonih) svoja leđa iz želje i straha, jer nema skloništa ni spasilišta pred Tobom osim kod Tebe. Vjerujem u Tvoju Knjigu, koju si spustio, i u Tvoga Vjerovjesnika, koga si poslao.
translation.en: O Allah, I submit myself to You, entrust my affairs to You, turn my face to You, and lay myself down depending upon You, hoping in You and fearing You. There is no refuge, and no escape, except to You. I believe in Your Book (the Qur'an) that You revealed, and the Prophet whom You sent.

sayings.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي.

instructions.bs: Pri buđenju noću proučiti ovu dovu, pa zamoliti Allaha za oprost ili Mu uputiti vlastitu dovu. U hadisu se navode oprost i uslišana dova, te primljen namaz ako se nakon toga uzme abdest i klanja.
instructions.en: On waking during the night, this supplication is recited, followed by asking Allah for forgiveness or making a personal supplication. The hadith mentions forgiveness and an answered supplication, as well as acceptance of prayer if ablution and prayer follow.

transcription.bs: Lā ilāhe illellāhu vaḥdehū lā šerīke leh, lehu-l-mulku ve lehu-l-ḥamdu, ve huve ‘alā kulli šej’in qadīr. Subḥānallāhi ve-l-ḥamdu lillāhi ve lā ilāhe illellāhu vallāhu ekber, ve lā ḥavle ve lā quvvete illā billāhi-l-‘Alijji-l-‘Aẓīm. Allāhumma-gfir lī.
transcription.en: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu, wa huwa ‘alā kulli shay’in qadīr. Subḥānallāhi wal-ḥamdu lillāhi wa lā ilāha illallāhu wallāhu akbar, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāhil-‘Aliyyil-‘Aẓīm. Allāhumma-ghfir lī.

translation.bs: Nema boga osim Allaha, Jedinoga, Koji Sebi ravnoga nema. Njemu vlast pripada i Njemu pripada svaka zahvalnost. Njegova je moć iznad svake druge moći, neka je slavljen Allah i neka Mu je hvala; nema boga osim Allaha. Allah je najveći. Nema moći i sile osim Allahove, Moćnog i Velikog. Allahu moj, oprosti mi.
translation.en: There is no god but Allah alone, without a partner. Dominion and praise are His, and He has power over all things. Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, and Allah is the greatest. There is no might or power except through Allah, the Most High, the Magnificent. O Allah, forgive me.

sayings.arabic: أعوذ بالله

instructions.bs: Nakon ružnog sna 3 puta lagano pljucnuti ulijevo i 3 puta zatražiti Allahovu zaštitu od šejtana i zla sna. Ne pričati san nikome i okrenuti se na drugi bok.
instructions.en: After a bad dream, the practice is to spit lightly to the left 3 times and seek Allah’s protection from Satan and the dream’s evil 3 times. The dream is not shared with anyone, and the sleeping position is changed to the other side.

transcription.bs: E‘ūḏu billāhi.
transcription.en: A'udhu billahi.

translation.bs: Utječem se Allahu.
translation.en: I seek refuge in Allah.

title.bs: Dova protiv nemira i straha u snu

sayings.arabic: أَعـوذُ بِكَلِمـاتِ اللّهِ التّـامّـاتِ مِن غَضَـبِهِ وَعِـقابِهِ وَشَـرِّ عِبـادِهِ وَمِنْ هَمَـزاتِ الشَّـياطينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضـرون

transcription.bs: E‘ūḏu bi kelimātillāhi-t-tāmmāti min gaḍabihi ve ‘iqābihi ve šerri ‘ibādihi ve min hemezāti-š-šejāṭīni ve en jaḥḍurūn.
transcription.en: A`ūdhu bikalimāti ‘llāhit-tāmmāti min ghaḍabihi wa `iqābihi wa sharri `ibādih, wa min hamazātish-shayāṭīni wa an yaḥḍurūn.

translation.bs: Zaštitu tražim pomoću Allahovih savršenih Riječi pred Njegovom srdžbom i Njegovom kaznom, protiv zla robova Njegovih te protiv šejtanskih nagovaranja na zlo i njihova prisustva.
translation.en: I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah from His anger and His punishment, from the evil of His slaves, and from the taunts of devils and from their presence.

title.en: When turning over during the night

sayings.arabic: لا إِلـهَ إِلاّ اللهُ الـواحِدُ القَهّـار رَبُّ السَّـمواتِ وَالأرْضِ وَما بَيْـنَهـما العَزيـزُ الغَـفّار

transcription.bs: Lā ilāhe illellāhu-l-Vāḥidu-l-Qahhāru Rabbi-s-semāvāti ve-l-erḍi ve mā bejnehume-l-‘Azīzu-l-Gaffār.
transcription.en: Lā ilāha illallāh al-Wāḥidul-Qahhār, Rabbus-samāwāti wa ‘l-arḍi wa mā baynahuma al-`Azīzul-Ghaffār.

translation.bs: Nema boga osim Allaha, Jednog i Silnog, Gospodara nebesa i Zemlje i prostora među njima, Silnog Oproštavatelja.
translation.en: There is none worthy of worship but Allah, the One, the Victorious, Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the All-Mighty, the All-Forgiving.

sayings.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ

instructions.bs: Staviti ruku na bolno mjesto i izgovoriti ovo 3 puta.
instructions.en: The hand is placed on the painful area, and these words are said 3 times.

transcription.bs: Bismillāh.
transcription.en: Bismillāh.

translation.bs: U ime Allaha.
translation.en: With the Name of Allah.

sayings.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ

instructions.bs: Zatim izgovoriti ovo 7 puta.
instructions.en: Then these words are said 7 times.

transcription.bs: E‘ūḏu billāhi ve qudretihī min šerri mā edžidu ve uḥāḏiru.
transcription.en: A`ūdhu billāhi wa qudratihi min sharri mā ajidu wa uḥādhir.

translation.bs: Tražim zaštitu od Allaha i Njegove svemoći protiv zla koga nalazim i koga se plašim.
translation.en: I seek refuge in Allah and in His Power from the evil of what I find and of what I guard against.

sayings.arabic: لا بأْسَ طَهـورٌ إِنْ شـاءَ الله

transcription.bs: Lā be’se, ṭahūrun inšā’ Allāh.
transcription.en: Lā ba'sa ṭahūrun in shā Allāh.

translation.bs: Ne bilo opasno. Allah ti s ovim grijehe očistio, ako Allah da.
translation.en: Do not worry, it will be a purification (for you), Allah willing.

sayings.arabic: أَسْـأَلُ اللهَ العَـظيـم، رَبَّ العَـرْشِ العَـظيـم أَنْ يَشْفـيك

instructions.bs: Pri posjeti bolesniku proučiti ovu dovu 7 puta.
instructions.en: This supplication is recited 7 times when visiting someone who is ill.

transcription.bs: Es’elullāhe-l-‘aẓīm Rabbe-l-‘Arši-l-‘aẓīmi en ješfijeke.
transcription.en: As’alullāha ‘l-`Aẓīma Rabba ‘l-`Arshil-`Aẓīmi an yashfiyak.

translation.bs: Molim Uzvišenog Allaha, Gospodara Prijestolja velikog, da ti da zdravlje.
translation.en: I ask Almighty Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, to make you well.

title.en: Supplication near the end of life

sayings.arabic: أللّهُـمَّ اغْفِـرْ لي وَارْحَمْـني وَأَلْحِقْـني بِالرَّفـيقِ الأّعْلـى

transcription.bs: Allāhumma-gfir lī ve-rḥamnī ve elḥiqnī bi-r-refīqi-l-a‘lā.
transcription.en: Allāhumma’ghfir lī warḥamnī wa alḥiqnī bir-rafīqi ‘l-'A`alā.

translation.bs: Allahu, oprosti mi i smiluj mi se. Pridruži me društvu najvišem.
translation.en: O Allah, forgive me and have mercy upon me, and join me with the highest companions (in Paradise).

title.bs: Podsjećanje čovjeka na samrti da izgovori šehadet
title.en: Instruction for the one nearing death

sayings.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ

instructions.bs: Poslanik ﷺ je rekao da će onaj kome ove riječi budu posljednje ući u Džennet.
instructions.en: The Prophet ﷺ said that whoever dies with these as their last words will enter Paradise.

transcription.bs: Lā ilāhe illellāh.
transcription.en: Lā ilāha illallāh.

translation.bs: Nema boga osim Allaha.
translation.en: There is none worthy of worship but Allah.

sayings.arabic: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى، وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى، فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ

transcription.bs: Inne lillāhi mā eḫaḏe, ve lehū mā e‘ṭā ve kullu šej’in ‘indehū bi edželin musemmā, fe-l-taṣbir ve-l-taḥtesib.
transcription.en: Inna lillāhi mā akhadh, wa lahu mā a`tā, wa kullu shay'in `indahu bi ajalin musammā . . . faltaṣbir wa ‘l-taḥtasib.

translation.bs: Allahu pripada ono što je uzeo i Njegovo je ono što je On dao. Kod Njega sve ima određeni rok. Zato, strpi se i nadaj se nagradi.
translation.en: Surely, Allah takes what is His, and what He gives is His, and to all things He has appointed a time... so have patience and be rewarded.

sayings.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَاخْلُفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا

transcription.bs: Innā lillāhi ve innā ilejhi rādži‘ūn. Allāhumme’džurnī fī muṣībetī vaḫluf lī ḫajren minhā.
transcription.en: Innā lillāhi wa innā ilayhi rāji`ūn, Allāhumma-jurni fī muṣībatī wa 'khluf lī khayran minhā.

translation.bs: Mi zaista pripadamo Allahu i svi Mu se, bez dvoumljenja, vraćamo. Allahu, daruj mi u ovome mom musibetu (nesreći) nagradu (za sabur) i nakon toga mi podari veće dobro.
translation.en: We are from Allah and unto Him we return. O Allah take me out of my plight and bring to me after it something better.

sayings.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ، وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ، وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ، وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الْأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلًا خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، وَزَوْجًا خَيْرًا مِنْ زَوْجِهِ، وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ ⁠⁦)⁩⁠وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ⁠⁦(⁩⁠

transcription.bs: Allāhumma-gfir lehū ve-rḥamhū ve ‘āfihī va‘fu ‘anhū ve ekrim nuzulehū ve vessi‘ mudḫalehū vagsilhū bi-l-māi ve-s-ṯeldži ve-l-berdi ve neqqihī mine-l-ḫaṭājā kemā neqqajte-s-ṯevbe-l-ebjeḍa mine-d-denisi ve ebdilhū dāren ḫajren min dārihī ve ehlen ḫajren min ehlihī ve zevdžen ḫajren min zevdžihī ve edḫilhū-l-džennete ve e‘iḏhū min ‘aḏābi-l-qabri (ve ‘aḏābi-n-nāri).
transcription.en: Allāhumma’ghfir lahu warḥamh, wa `āfihi, wa`fu `anh, wa akrim nuzulah, wa wassi` mudkhalah, wagh’silhu bi ‘lmā'i wath-thalji walbarad, wa naqqihi mina ‘l-khaṭāyā kamā naqqaytath-thawba ‘l-abyaḍa minad-danas, wa abdilhu dāran khayran min dārih, wa ahlan khayran min ahlih, wa zawjan khayran min zawjih, wa adkhilhu ‘l-jannah, wa a`idhhu min `adhābi ‘l-qabri [wa `adhābin-nār].

translation.bs: Allahu, oprosti mu i smiluj se, grijehe mu pobriši i sačuvaj ga, nagradi ga počasnim mjestom i učini širokim njegov ulaz (kabur), očisti ga vodom, snijegom i ledom, očisti ga od grijeha kao što bijelu odjeću čistiš od prljavštine. Zamijeni mu njegovu dunjalučku kuću za bolju od nje (ahiretsku), i njegovu porodicu za bolju, i njegovu suprugu za bolju od njegove dunjalučke. U Džennet ga uvedi i zaštiti ga od zagrobne kazne (i od džehenemske vatre).
translation.en: O Allah, forgive him and have mercy on him, and give him strength and pardon him. Be generous to him, and cause his entrance to be wide, and wash him with water and snow and hail. Cleanse him of his transgressions as white cloth is cleansed of stains. Give him an abode better than his home, and a family better than his family, and a wife better than his wife. Take him into Paradise, and protect him from the punishment of the grave [and from the punishment of Hell-fire].

title.en: When the deceased is a child, during the funeral prayer

sayings.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ فَرَطًا وَذُخْرًا لِوَالِدَيْهِ، وَشَفِيعًا مُجَابًا. اللَّهُمَّ ثَقِّلْ بِهِ مَوَازِينَهُمَا وَأَعْظِمْ بِهِ أُجُورَهُمَا، وَأَلْحِقْهُ بِصَالِحِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَاجْعَلْهُ فِي كَفَالَةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَقِهِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ

transcription.bs: Allāhumme-dž‘alhu fereṭan ve ḏuḫren li-vālidejhi ve šefi‘an mudžāben. Allāhumme ṯeqqil bihī mevāzīnehumā ve e‘ẓim bihī udžūrehumā ve elḥiqhu bi ṣāliḥi-l-mu’minīne ve-dž‘alhu fī kefāleti Ibrāhīme ve qihī bi Raḥmetike ‘aḏābe-l-džeḥīm.
transcription.en: Allāhumma ‘j`alhu faraṭan wa dhukhran liwālidayh, wa shafī`an mujāban. Allāhumma thaqqil bihi mawāzīnahumā wa a`ẓim bihi ujūrahumā, wa alḥiqhu biṣāliḥi ‘l-mu'minīn, waj`alhu fī kafālati Ibrāhīm, wa qihi biraḥmatika `adhāba ‘l-jaḥīm.

translation.bs: Allahu, učini ovo maloljetno dijete predvodnikom i zalihom njegovim roditeljima i zagovornikom čijem će zagovaranju biti udovoljeno. Allahu, učini da, s njegovim zagovaranjem, dobra djela njegovih roditelja budu teža na vrijednosti te povećaj nagradu njegovim roditeljima radi njega. Sjedini ga s dobrim vjernicima i učini da bude u okrilju Ibrahima, a.s. Svojom milošću ga zaštiti od (džehenemske) vatre.
translation.en: O Allah, make him a precursor, a forerunner and a treasure for his parents and an answered intercessor. O Allah, make him weigh heavily in their scales (of good) and magnify their reward. Make him join the righteous of the believers. Place him in the care of Ibrahim. Save him by Your mercy from the torment of Hell.

title.en: When closing the eyes of the deceased

sayings.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِفُلَانٍ وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ فِي الْمَهْدِيِّينَ، وَاخْلُفْهُ فِي عَقِبِهِ فِي الْغَابِرِينَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ، وَافْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ

transcription.bs: Allāhumma-gfir li ..(spomenuti ime umrlog) ve-rfa‘ deredžetehū fī-l-mehdijjīne vaḫlufhu fī ‘aqibihī fī-l-gābirīne va-gfir lenā ve lehū, jā Rabbe-l-‘ālemīne, vefsaḥ lehū fī qabrihī ve nevvir lehū fīhī.
transcription.en: Allāhumma’ghfir li (name of the person) warfa` darajatahu fi ‘l-mahdiyyīn, wakhlufhu fī `aqibihi fi ‘l-ghābirīn, wagh’fir-lanā wa lahu yā Rabba ‘l-`ālamīn, wafsaḥ lahu fī qabrihi wa nawwir lahu fīh.

translation.bs: Allahu, oprosti (tome i tome, po imenu), uzdigni njegovo mjesto među onima koji su zaradili Tvoju uputu (Džennet) i odredi mu nasljednika među onima koji ostaju (od njegovih potomaka). Oprosti nama i njemu, Gospodaru svjetova. Kabur mu učini širokim prostorom i udobnim i osvijetli mu ga.
translation.en: O Allah, forgive [name of the person] and elevate his station among those who are guided. Send him along the path of those who came before, and forgive us and him, O Lord of the worlds. Enlarge for him his grave, and shed light upon him in it.

title.bs: Dova prilikom spuštanja umrlog u kabur
title.en: When placing the deceased in the grave

sayings.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ

transcription.bs: Bismillāhi ve ‘alā sunneti Resūlillāhi.
transcription.en: Bismillāh wa `alā sunnati Rasūlillāh.

translation.bs: S Allahovim imenom i po sunnetu Allahova Poslanika (postupamo).
translation.en: With the Name of Allah, and according to the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah.

sayings.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُونَ، [وَيَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ الْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنَّا وَالْمُسْتَأْخِرِينَ] نَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ

transcription.bs: Es-selāmu ‘alejkum ehle-l-dijāri mine-l-mu’minīne ve-l-muslimīne ve innā, in šā’ Allāhu bikum lāḥiqūne. Ve jerḥamullāhu el-mustaqdimīne minnā vel-muste’ḫirīne. Nes’elullāhe lenā ve lekumu-l-‘āfije.
transcription.en: Assalāmu `alaykum ahlad-diyāri minal-mu'minīna wa ‘l-muslimīn, wa innā in shā' Allāhu bikum lāḥiqūn nas'alullāha lanā wa lakumul-`āfiyah.

translation.bs: Selam vama, stanovnici smrtničkih domova vjernika muslimana. Mi ćemo se, ako Allah da, priključiti vama. Allaha molimo da nama i vama oprost Svoj dadne.
translation.en: Peace be upon you, people of this abode, from among the believers and those who are Muslims, and we, by the Will of Allah, shall be joining you. [May Allah have mercy on the first of us and the last of us] I ask Allah to grant us and you well-being.

sayings.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ

transcription.bs: Lā ilāhe illā Ente, subḥāneke innī kuntu mine-ẓ-ẓālimīne.
transcription.en: Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu minaẓ-ẓālimīn.

translation.bs: Nema boga osim Tebe, slavljen neka si, ja sam se uistinu prema sebi ogriješio.
translation.en: There is none worthy of worship but You, glory is to You. Surely, I was among the wrongdoers.

title.bs: Dova pri susretu s neprijateljem ili osobom na vlasti

sayings.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِمْ، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ

transcription.bs: Allāhumme innā nedž‘aluke fī nuḥūrihim ve ne‘ūḏu bike min šurūrihim.
transcription.en: Allāhumma innā naj`aluka fī nuḥūrihim wa na`ūdhu bika min shurūrihim.

translation.bs: Allahu, molimo Te da njihove spletke usmjeriš na njih i kod Tebe se sklanjamo pred njihovim zlima.
translation.en: O Allah, we ask You to restrain them by their necks, and we seek refuge in You from their evil.

sayings.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ

transcription.bs: E‘ūḏu billāhi.
transcription.en: A`ūdhu billāh.

translation.bs: Utječem se Allahu.
translation.en: I seek refuge in Allah.

sayings.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا

transcription.bs: Allāhumme lā sehle illā mā dže‘altehū sehlen ve Ente tedže‘alu-l-ḥazene, iḏā ši’te sehlen.
transcription.en: Allāhumma lā sahla illā mā ja‘altahu sahlan, wa anta taj‘alu-l-ḥazna idhā shi’ta sahlan.

translation.bs: Allahu moj, ne može biti lahko osim onog što Ti učiniš lahkim, Ti, ako hoćeš, i teško učiniš lahkim!
translation.en: O Allah! There is nothing easy except what You make easy, and You make the difficult easy if it is Your will.

sayings.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ

transcription.bs: E‘ūḏu billāhi mine-š-šejṭāni-r-radžīm.
transcription.en: A`ūdhu billāhi minash-Shayṭānir-rajīm.

translation.bs: Allaha prizivam protiv prokletog šejtana.
translation.en: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.

title.en: Upon seeing someone in trial or tribulation

sayings.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلًا

transcription.bs: El-ḥamdu lillāhi-l-leḏī ‘āfānī mimmab-telāke bihī ve feḍḍalenī ‘alā keṯīrin mimmen ḫaleqa tafḍīlā.
transcription.en: Alhamdu lillāhi ‘l-ladhī `āfānī mimmab-talāka bihi wa faḍḍalanī `alā kathīrin mimman khalaqa tafḍīlā.

translation.bs: Hvala Allahu, Koji me zaštiti od onoga što je tebe zadesilo i dade mi prednost nad mnogo čime što je stvorio.
translation.en: Praise is to Allah Who has spared me what He has afflicted you with, and preferred me greatly above much of what He has created.

title.bs: Dova kojom se moli Allahova zaštita od Dedžala

sayings.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ

transcription.bs: E‘ūḏu billāhi min fitnetil-mesīḥi-d-dedždžāli.
transcription.en: A`ūdhu billāhi min fitnati ‘l-masīḥid-dajjāl.

translation.bs: Allahu, prizivam Te da me sačuvaš od kušnji Mesiha Dedžala.
translation.en: I seek refuge in You from the trial of the False Messiah.

title.bs: Dova za zaštitu od straha pred širkom
title.en: Fear of associating partners with Allah

sayings.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ إِنّـي أَعـوذُبِكَ أَنْ أُشْـرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنا أَعْـلَمْ، وَأَسْتَـغْفِرُكَ لِما لا أَعْـلَم

transcription.bs: Allāhumme innī e‘ūḏu bike en ušrike bike ve ene a‘lemu ve estagfiruke limā lā a‘lemu.
transcription.en: Allāhumma innī a`ūdhu bika an ushrika bika wa anā a`lam, wa astaghfiruka limā lā a`lam.

translation.bs: Allahu, zaštiti me da prema Tebi ne počinim svjesno širk i molim Te da mi oprostiš za ono što počinim nesvjesno.
translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I associate anything with You knowingly, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I know not.

sayings.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَاب سَرِيعَ الْحِسَاب اهْزِم الأَحْزَاب اللَّهُمَّ اهْزِمْهُمْ وَ زَلْزِلْهُم

transcription.bs: Allāhumme Munzile-l-Kitābi, Serī‘a-l-ḥisābi ihzimi-l-aḥzābe. Allāhumme, ihzimhum ve zelzilhum.
transcription.en: Allāhumma munzila ‘l-kitāb, sarī`a ‘l-ḥisāb, ihzimi ‘l-aḥzāb, Allāhumma-hzimhum wa zalzilhum.

translation.bs: Allahu, Dostavitelju Knjige, Koji brzo svodiš račune, porazi protivnike. Allahu, porazi ih sve i uzdrmaj ih (razori ih).
translation.en: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift to account, defeat the groups (of disbelievers). O Allah, defeat them and shake them.

title.bs: Dova prilikom straha od grupe ljudi
title.en: When afraid of a group of people

sayings.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيهِم بمَا شِئْت

transcription.bs: Allāhumme-kfinīhim bi mā ši’te.
transcription.en: Allāhummak-finīhim bimā shi't.

translation.bs: Allahu, sačuvaj me od njih čime Ti je volja.
translation.en: O Allah, suffice (i.e. protect) me against them however You wish.

sayings.arabic: بِسـمِ اللهِ الذي لا يَضُـرُّ مَعَ اسمِـهِ شَيءٌ في الأرْضِ وَلا في السّمـاءِ وَهـوَ السّمـيعُ العَلـيم .

instructions.bs: Proučiti ovu dovu 3 puta ujutro i 3 puta navečer. U hadisu se navodi da jutarnje učenje štiti od iznenadne nedaće do večeri, a večernje do jutra.
instructions.en: This supplication is recited 3 times in the morning and 3 times in the evening. The hadith mentions protection from sudden affliction until evening after the morning recitation, and until morning after the evening recitation.

transcription.bs: Bismillāhi-l-leḏī lā jeḍurru me‘a-smihi šej’un fī-l-erḍi ve lā fī-s-semā’i ve Huve-s-Semī‘u-l-‘Alīm.
transcription.en: Bismillāhi ‘l-ladhī lā yaḍurru ma`a-smihi shay'un fil-'arḍi wa lā fis-samā' wa huwas-Samī `ul-`Alīm.

translation.bs: S Allahovim imenom, kad se Njegovo ime spomene, nikakvo zlo na Zemlji ni na nebesima ne može štetiti.
translation.en: In the Name of Allah, Who with His Name nothing can cause harm in the earth nor in the heavens, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

sayings.arabic: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ

transcription.bs: U‘īḏukumā bi kelimātillāhi-t-tāmmāti min kulli šejtānin ve hāmmetin, ve min kulli ‘ajnin lāmmetin.
transcription.en: U`īthukumā bikalimāti ‘llāhit-tāmmati min kulli shayṭānin wa hāmmah, wa min kulli `aynin lāmmah.

translation.bs: Zaštitu Allahovu molim za vas pomoću Allahovih savršenih riječi od svakog šejtana, zloslutnje i od zloga pogleda.
translation.en: I seek protection for you in the Perfect Words of Allah from every devil and every beast, and from every envious blameworthy eye.

sayings.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ

transcription.bs: Allāhumme-kfinī bi ḥalālike ‘an ḥarāmike, ve agninī bi faḍlike ‘ammen sivāke.
transcription.en: Allāhummak-finī biḥalālika `an ḥarāmik, wa 'aghninī bi faḍlika `amman siwāk.

translation.bs: Allahu, zaštiti me Svojim halalom od Svoga harama i iz obilja Tvoga me učini bogatim (neovisnim) od svakoga drugog osim Tebe.
translation.en: O Allah, suffice me with what You have allowed instead of what You have forbidden, and make me independent of all others besides You.

sayings.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحُزْنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ

transcription.bs: Allāhumme innī e‘ūḏu bike mine-l-hemmi vel-ḥazeni ve-l-‘adžzi ve-l-keseli ve-l-buḫli ve-l-džubni ve ḍal‘i-d-dejni ve galebeti-r-ridžāli.
transcription.en: Allāhumma 'innī 'a`ūdhu bika mina ‘l-ḥammi wa ‘l-ḥuzn, wa ‘l-`ajzi wa ‘l-kasal, wa ‘l-bukhli wa ‘l-jubn, wa ḍala`id-dayn, wa ghalabatir-rijāl.

translation.bs: Allahu, tražim od Tebe zaštitu od brige i žalosti, od iznemoglosti i lijenosti, tvrdičluka i uspaničenosti te pred teretom dugovanja i ljudske nadmoći.
translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from grief and sadness, from weakness and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from being overcome by debt and overpowered by others.

title.bs: Dova prilikom vraćanja duga za onoga ko ti je posudio
title.en: To one who has offered you some of his wealth

sayings.arabic: بارَكَ اللهُ لَكَ في أَهْلِكَ وَمالِك

transcription.bs: Bārekellāhu leke fī ehlike ve mālike.
transcription.en: Bārakallāhu laka fī ahlika wa mālik.

translation.bs: Allah ti dao blagoslov u tvojoj porodici i tvojoj imovini.
translation.en: May Allah bless you in your family and your property.

sayings.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا

transcription.bs: Rabbenā heb lenā min ezvādžinā ve ḏurrijjātinā qurrate e‘junin ve-dž‘alnā li-l-muttaqīne imāmā.
transcription.en: Rabbanā hab lanā min azwājinā wa dhurriyyātinā qurrata a`yunin wa-j`alnā lil-muttaqīna imāmā.

translation.bs: Gospodaru naš, podari nam u ženama našim i potomstvu našem radost očiju i učini nas predvodnicima bogobojaznih.
translation.en: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous.

title.bs: Dova prije spolnog odnosa u braku
title.en: Before sexual intercourse with the wife

sayings.arabic: بِسْمِ الله اللّهُـمَّ جَنِّبْنا الشَّيْـطانَ، وَجَنِّبِ الشَّـيْطانَ ما رَزَقْـتَنا

transcription.bs: Bismillāh. Allāhumme džennibne-š-šejṭāne ve džennibi-š-šejṭāne mā rezaqtenā.
transcription.en: Bismillāh. Allāhumma jannibnash-Shayṭān, wa jannibish-Shayṭāna mā razaqtanā.

translation.bs: Allahu, skloni nas od šejtana i skloni šejtana od onoga čime si nas opskrbio.
translation.en: With the Name of Allah. O Allah, keep the Devil away from us, and keep the Devil away from that which You provide for us.

sayings.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ

transcription.bs: Allāhumme innī es’eluke ḫajrehā ve ḫajre mā džebeltehā ‘alejhi ve e‘ūḏu bike min šerrihā ve šerri mā džebeltehā ‘alejhi.
transcription.en: Allāhumma innī as'aluka khayrahā wa khayra mā jabaltahā `alayh, wa a`ūdhu bika min sharrihā wa sharri mā jabaltahā `alayh.

translation.bs: Allahu, molim Te da mi u njoj (ili njemu) podariš dobro i da ono čemu je ona (ili on) po naravi sklon(a), bude dobro. I utičem Ti se od njenoga (njegovoga) zla i zla onoga čemu je po prirodi sklon(a).
translation.en: O Allah, I ask You for the goodness of her, and the goodness upon which You have created her, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of her, and from the evil upon which You have created her.

sayings.arabic: بارَكَ اللّهُ لَك، وَبارَكَ عَلَـيْك، وَجَمَعَ بَيْـنَكُما في خَـيْر

transcription.bs: Bārekallāhu leke ve bāreke ‘alejke ve džeme‘a bejnekumā fī ḫajrin.
transcription.en: Bārakallāhu lak, wa bāraka `alayk, wa jama`a baynakumā fī khayr.

translation.bs: Allah te blagoslovio i svakom te blagodati obasuo. Allah vas sjedinio u dobru.
translation.en: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and join you together in goodness.

sayings.arabic: الحمدُ للهِ الّذي كَساني هذا الثّوب وَرَزَقَنيه مِنْ غَـيـْرِ حَولٍ مِنّي وَلا قـوّة

transcription.bs: El-ḥamdu lillāhi-lleḏī kesānī hāḏā eṯ-ṯevbe ve rezaqanīhi min gajri ḥavlin minnī ve lā quvvetin.
transcription.en: Alḥamdu lillāhil-ladhī kasānī hādhā (aththawba) wa razaqanīhi min ghayri hawlim-minnī wa lā quwwah.

translation.bs: Hvala Allahu, Koji me odjenuo ovom odjećom i Koji me opskrbio bez moje snage i moći.
translation.en: Praise is to Allah Who has clothed me with this (garment) and provided it for me, though I was powerless myself and incapable.

sayings.arabic: بِسْمِ الله

transcription.bs: Bismillāh.
transcription.en: Bismillāhi

translation.bs: U ime Allaha.
translation.en: In the Name of Allah.

sayings.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ لَـكَ الحَـمْـدُ أنْـتَ كَسَـوْتَنيهِ، أََسْأََلُـكَ مِـنْ خَـيرِهِ وَخَـيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَـه، وَأَعوذُ بِكَ مِـنْ شَـرِّهِ وَشَـرِّ مـا صُنِعَ لَـهُ

transcription.bs: Allāhumme leke-l-ḥamdu, Ente kesevtenīhi. Es’eluke min ḫajrihi ve ḫajri mā ṣuni‘a lehu. Ve e‘ūḏu bike min šerrihi ve šerri mā ṣuni‘a lehu.
transcription.en: Allāhumma lakal-ḥamdu 'anta kasawtanīhi, 'as'aluka min khayrihi wa khayri mā ṣuni`a lahu, wa 'a`oothu bika min sharrihi wa sharri mā ṣuni`a lahu.

translation.bs: Allahu moj, Tebi hvala. Ti si me ovim odjenuo. Molim Te da mi u tome daš dobro i dobro u onom zbog čega je spravljena, a utječem Ti se od protiv zla njegova i zla onoga zbog čega je spravljena.
translation.en: O Allah, praise is to You. You have clothed me. I ask You for its goodness and the goodness of what it has been made for, and I seek Your protection from the evil of it and the evil of what it has been made for.

title.bs: Dova onome ko odjene novu odjeću
title.en: To someone wearing a new garment

sayings.arabic: تُبْـلي وَيُـخْلِفُ اللهُ تَعَالى

transcription.bs: Tublī ve juḫlifullāhu te‘ālā.
transcription.en: Tublī wa yukhliful-lāhu ta`ālā.

translation.bs: Iznosio je, a novom ti Allah nadomjestio.
translation.en: May Allah replace it when it is worn out.

sayings.arabic: رب اغفر لي وتب علي إنك أنت التواب الغفور

transcription.bs: Rabbi-gfir lī ve tub ‘alejje inneke Ente-t-Tevvābu-l-Gafūr.
transcription.en: Rabbigh’fir lī wa tub `alayy innaka antat-Tawwābu ‘l-Ghafūr.

translation.bs: Gospodaru moj, oprosti mi i primi moje pokajanje, jer Ti si, zaista, Onaj Koji primaš pokajanja i opraštaš grijehe.
translation.en: My Lord, forgive me, and accept my repentance, You are the Ever-Relenting, the All-Forgiving.

title.bs: Dova kojom se završavaju sva sijela

sayings.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ وَبِحَمْدِكَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ

transcription.bs: Subḥāneke ve biḥamdike, lā ilāhe illā Ente, estagfiruke ve etūbu ilejke.
transcription.en: Subhanaka wa bihamdika la ilaha illa anta astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk

translation.bs: Neka si slavljen i hvaljen, Allahu moj. Nema Boga osim Tebe, Tebe ja molim za oprost grijeha i Tebi se iskreno kajem.
translation.en: Glory is to You and with Your praise, there is no true deity except You, I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You

title.bs: Dova za iskupljenje grijeha na sijelu
title.en: At the end of a gathering

sayings.arabic: سُبْحـانَكَ اللّهُـمَّ وَبِحَمدِك، أَشْهَـدُ أَنْ لا إِلهَ إِلاّ أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتوبُ إِلَـيْك

transcription.bs: Subḥāneke Allāhumme ve biḥamdike, ešhedu en lā ilāhe illā Ente, estagfiruke ve etūbu ilejke.
transcription.en: Subhānaka Allāhumma wa biḥamdik, ash-hadu an lā ilāha illā ant, astaghfiruka wa atību ilayk.

translation.bs: Neka si slavljen, Allahu, i neka Ti je hvala. Svjedočim da nema boga osim Tebe. Od Tebe tražim oprost i Tebi se kajem.
translation.en: Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise is to You. I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.

sayings.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ

transcription.bs: Allāhumme innī es’eluke ḫajrehā ve ḫajre mā džebeltehā ‘alejhi ve e‘ūḏu bike min šerrihā ve šerri mā džebeltehā ‘alejhi.
transcription.en: Allāhumma innī as'aluka khayrahā wa khayra mā jabaltahā `alayh, wa a`ūdhu bika min sharrihā wa sharri mā jabaltahā `alayh.

translation.bs: Allahu, molim Te da mi u njoj (ili njemu) podariš dobro i da ono čemu je ona (ili on) po naravi sklon(a), bude dobro. I utičem Ti se od njenoga (njegovoga) zla i zla onoga čemu je po prirodi sklon(a).
translation.en: O Allah, I ask You for the goodness of her, and the goodness upon which You have created her, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of her, and from the evil upon which You have created her.

sayings.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ

transcription.bs: Allāhumme innī es’eluke min faḍlike.
transcription.en: Allahumma innee as'aluka min fadlik

translation.bs: Allahu moj, podari mi svako dobro od Tebe.
translation.en: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty.

title.bs: Dova kada noću čujemo zavijanje pasa ili revanje magaraca
title.en: Upon hearing dogs bark or donkeys bray at night

sayings.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ

transcription.bs: E‘ūḏu billāhi mineš-šejṭāni-r-radžīm.
transcription.en: A'oodhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem

translation.bs: Utječem se Allahu od prokletog šejtana.
translation.en: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan.

sayings.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ إِنَّـي أَسْـأَلُـكَ خَيْـرَها، وَأَعـوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَـرِّها

transcription.bs: Allāhumme innī es’eluke ḫajrehā, ve e‘ūḏu bike min šerrihā.
transcription.en: Allāhumma innī as'aluka khayrahā, wa a`ūdhu bika min sharrihā.

translation.bs: Allahu, molim Te da nam u njemu daš dobro i zaštitu Tvoju tražim od zla njegova.
translation.en: O Allah, I ask You for the good of it, and seek refuge in You against its evil.

sayings.arabic: سُبْـحانَ الّذي يُسَبِّـحُ الـرَّعْدُ بِحَمْـدِهِ، وَالملائِكـةُ مِنْ خيـفَته

transcription.bs: Subḥāne-l-leḏī jusebbiḥu-r-ra‘du biḥamdihi, vel-melā’iketu min ḫīfetih.
transcription.en: Subḥāna ‘l-ladhī yusabbiḥur-ra`du bi ḥamdihi wa ‘l-malā'ikatu min khīfatih.

translation.bs: Slava Onome Kojega grom slavi hvalom, a i meleki iz straha prema njemu.
translation.en: Glory is to Him Whom thunder and angels glorify due to fear of Him.

sayings.arabic: اللّهُمَّ اسْقِـنا غَيْـثاً مُغيـثاً مَريئاً مُريـعاً، نافِعـاً غَيْـرَ ضار، عاجِـلاً غَـيْرَ آجِل

transcription.bs: Allāhumme esqinā gajṯen mugīṯen merī’en murī‘an, nāfi‘an gajre ḍārrin, ‘ādžilen gajre ādžil.
transcription.en: Allāhumma ‘asqinā ghaythan mughīthan marī'an murī`a, nāfi`an ghayra ḍārr, `ājilan ghayra ājil.

translation.bs: Allahu, spusti nam posvuda kišu, prijatnu, obilnu i plodnu, korisnu i neštetnu, što brže i bez odlaganja.
translation.en: O Allah, shower upon us abundant rain, beneficial not harmful, swiftly and not delayed.

sayings.arabic: اللّهُمَّ صَيِّـباً نافِـعاً

transcription.bs: Allāhumme ṣajjiben nāfi‘an.
transcription.en: Allāhumma ṣayyiban nāfi`a.

translation.bs: Allahu, molim Te za obilnu i korisnu kišu.
translation.en: O Allah, (bring) beneficial rain clouds.

sayings.arabic: مُطِـرْنا بِفَضْـلِ اللهِ وَرَحْمَـتِه

transcription.bs: Muṭirnā bi faḍlillāhi ve raḥmetihī.
transcription.en: Muṭirnā bifaḍlillāhi wa raḥmatih.

translation.bs: Kiša nam je podarena dobrotom Allahovom i Njegovom milošću.
translation.en: We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.

sayings.arabic: اللّهُمَّ حَوالَيْنا وَلا عَلَيْـنا، اللّهُمَّ عَلى الآكـامِ وَالظِّـراب، وَبُطـونِ الأوْدِية، وَمَنـابِتِ الشَّجـر

transcription.bs: Allāhumme ḥavālejnā ve lā ‘alejnā. Allāhumme ‘ale-l-ākāmi ve-ẓ-ẓirābi, ve buṭūni-l-evdijeti, ve menābiti-š-šedžeri.
transcription.en: Allāhumma ḥawālaynā wa lā `alaynā. Allāhumma `ala ‘l-ākāmi waẓ-ẓirāb, wa buṭūni ‘l-awdiyati, wa manābitish-shajar.

translation.bs: Allahu, izvan naše okoline spusti ove kiše, a ne na nas. Allahu, na zaravni i brežuljke, u utrobe dolina i korjeništa drveća (isprazni kišne oblake).
translation.en: O Allah, let the rain fall around us and not upon us, O Allah, (let it fall) on the pastures, hills, valleys, and the roots of trees.

sayings.arabic: اللهُ أَكْـبَر، اللّهُمَّ أَهِلَّـهُ عَلَيْـنا بِالأمْـنِ وَالإيمـان، والسَّلامَـةِ والإسْلام، وَالتَّـوْفيـقِ لِما تُحِـبُّ رَبَّنـا وَتَـرْضـى، رَبُّنـا وَرَبُّكَ الله

transcription.bs: Allāhu ekber, Allāhumme ehillehu ‘alejnā bi-l-emni ve-l-īmāni ve-s-selāmeti ve-l-islāmi ve-t-tevfīqi limā tuḥibbu rabbenā ve terḍā, rabbunā ve rabbuke-llāhu.
transcription.en: Allāhu Akbar, Allāhumma ahillahu `alayna bi ‘l-amni wa ‘l-īmān, was-salāmati wa ‘l-'Islām, wat-tawfīqi limā tuḥibbu Rabbanā wa tarḍā, Rabbunā wa Rabbukallāh.

translation.bs: Allah je najveći, Allahu, učini da nam ovaj mjesec nastupi u znaku sigurnosti i imana, mira i islama, te pomoći u onome što Ti voliš i čime si zadovoljan. Naš Gospodar i tvoj Gospodar (Mjeseče) jest Allah.
translation.en: Allah is the Most Great. O Allah, bring us the new moon with security and Faith, with peace and in Islam, and in harmony with what our Lord loves and what pleases Him. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.

sayings.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ ، تَوَكَّلْـتُ عَلى اللهِ وَلا حَوْلَ وَلا قُـوَّةَ إِلاّ بِالله

transcription.bs: Bismillāhi, tevekkeltu ‘alellāhi, ve lā ḥavle ve lā quvvete illā billāhi.
transcription.en: Bismillāhi, tawakkaltu `alallāhi, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh.

translation.bs: U ime Allaha, u Allaha se pouzdavam, nema snage niti moći bez Allahove snage i moći.
translation.en: In the Name of Allah, I have placed my trust in Allah, there is no might and no power except by Allah.

sayings.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا

transcription.bs: Bismillāhi veledžnā ve bismillāhi ḫaredžnā ve ‘alā Rabbinā tevekkelnā.
transcription.en: Bismillāhi walajnā, wa bismillāhi kharajnā, wa `ala Rabbinā tawakkalnā

translation.bs: S Allahovim imenom ulazimo i s Allahovim imenom izlazimo. Na Gospodara našega se oslanjamo.
translation.en: In the Name of Allah we enter , in the Name of Allah we leave , and upon our Lord we depend

sayings.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ * وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ﴾ اللَّهُمَّ إِنّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا البِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَليفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ

transcription.bs: Allāhu ekber, Allāhu ekber, Allāhu ekber. Subḥāne-l-leḏī seḫḫare lenā hāḏā ve mā kunnā lehū muqrinīne, ve innā ilā Rabbinā le munqalibūn. Allāhumme innā nes’eluke fī seferinā hāḏā el-birre, ve-t-taqvā ve mine-l-‘ameli mā terḍā. Allāhumme hevvin ‘alejnā seferenā hāḏā va-ṭvi ‘annā bu‘dehū. Allāhumme Ente-ṣ-Ṣāḥibu fī-s-seferi ve-l-ḫalīfetu fī-l-ehli. Allāhumme innī e‘ūḏu bike min ve‘ṯā’i-s-seferi ve ke’ābeti-l-menzari ve sū’i-l-munqalebi fī-l-māli ve-l-ehli.
transcription.en: Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu Akbar, Subḥāna ‘l-ladhi sakhkhara lanā hādhā wa mā kunnā lahu muqrinīn. Wa innā ilā Rabbinā lamunqalibūn. Allāhumma innā nas'aluka fī safarinā hādha ‘l-birra wat-taqwā, Wa mina ‘l-`amali mā tarḍā, Allāhumma hawwin `alaynā safaranā hādhā waṭwi `annā bu`dah, Allāhumma antas-sāḥibu fis-safar, wa ‘l-khalīfatu fil-ahl, Allāhumma innī a`ūdhu bika min wa`thā'is-safar, wa ka'ābati ‘l-manẓar, wa sū'il-munqalabi fil-māli wa ‘l-ahl.

translation.bs: Allah je najveći, Allah je najveći, Allah je najveći. Neka je slavljen Onaj Koji nam je ovo omogućio, a mi to ne bismo bili sposobni sami učiniti. Mi se, zaista, Gospodaru našem vraćamo. Allahu, molimo Te za dobročinstvo i bogobojaznost na ovom našem putu, i za djela kojima si Ti zadovoljan. Allahu, olakšaj nam ovo putovanje, a razdaljinu njegovu skrati. Ti si Pratioc na putu i Čuvar u porodici. Allahu, molim Te da me zaštitiš od teškoće na putu, ružnih prizora, te zla u imetku i (porodici kada se vratim).
translation.en: Allah is the Most Great. Allah is the Most Great. Allah is the Most Great. Glory is to Him Who has provided this for us though we could never have had it by our efforts. Surely, unto our Lord we are returning. O Allah, we ask You on this our journey for goodness and piety, and for works that are pleasing to You. O Allah, lighten this journey for us and make its distance easy for us. O Allah, You are our Companion on the road and the One in Whose care we leave our family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from this journey's hardships, and from the wicked sights in store and from finding our family and property in misfortune upon returning.

title.bs: Dova musafira koji porani na put

sayings.arabic: سَمِـعَ سـامِعٌ بِحَمْـدِ اللهِ وَحُسْـنِ بَلائِـهِ عَلَيْـنا. رَبَّنـا صـاحِبْـنا وَأَفْـضِل عَلَيْـنا عائِذاً باللهِ مِنَ النّـار

transcription.bs: Semi‘a sāmi‘un bi ḥamdillāhi ve ḥusni belā’ihi ‘alejnā. Rabbenā ṣāḥibnā ve efḍil ‘alejnā ‘ā’iḏen billāhi mine-n-nāri.
transcription.en: Sami`a sāmi`un biḥamdillāhi wa ḥusni balā'ihi `alaynā. Rabbanā ṣāḥibnā, wa afḍil `alaynā, `ā'idhan billāhi minan-nār.

translation.bs: Neka čuje (onaj koji sluša) naše hvaljenje Allaha, na lijepim blagodatima. Gospodaru naš, budi nam Pratilac (Zaštitnik) i obaspi nas Svojim obiljem. Allahu se utječemo od džehenemske vatre.
translation.en: He Who listens has heard that we praise Allah for the good things He gives us. Our Lord, be with us and bestow Your favor upon us. I seek the protection of Allah from the Fire.

sayings.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنا حَامِدُونَ، صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزابَ وَحْدَهُ

instructions.bs: Pri povratku s puta proučiti ovu dovu na svakom uzvišenju.
instructions.en: On the return journey, this supplication is recited at each elevated point.

transcription.bs: Allāhu ekber (tri puta). Lā ilāhe illellāhu vaḥdehū lā šerīke leh, lehu-l-mulku ve lehu-l-ḥamdu ve Huve ‘alā kulli šej’in Qadīr. Ājibūne, Tā’ibūne, ‘Ābidūne li Rabbinā ḥāmidūne. Ṣadeqallāhu va‘dehū ve neṣare ‘abdehū ve hezeme-l-aḥzābe vaḥdehū.
transcription.en: Allāhu Akbar (three times). Lā ilāha illallāh waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahu ‘l-mulku, walahu ‘l-ḥamd, wa Huwa `alā kulli shay'in Qadīr, ā'ibūna, tā'ibūna,`ābidūn, li Rabbinā ḥāmidūn, sadaqallāhu wa`dah, wa nasara `abdah, wa hazama ‘l-'aḥzāba waḥdah.

translation.bs: Nema boga osim Allaha, Jedinoga, Koji Sebi nema ravnoga. Njemu pripada sva vlast i zahvalnost. On je iznad svega drugoga. Vraćamo se i kajemo se obožavajući našega Gospodara i hvaleći Ga. Allah je obistinio Svoje obećanje, pomogao je Svome robu i sve protivnike Sam porazio.
translation.en: Allah is the Most Great. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is Able to do all things. We return repentant to our Lord, worshipping our Lord, and praising our Lord. He fulfilled His Promise, He aided His slave, and He alone defeated the Confederates.

sayings.arabic: أَعـوذُ بِكَلِـماتِ اللّهِ التّـامّاتِ مِنْ شَـرِّ ما خَلَـق

transcription.bs: E‘ūḏu bi kelimātillāhi-t-tāmmāti min šerri mā ḫaleqa.
transcription.en: A`ūdhu bikalimāti ‘llāhit-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq.

translation.bs: Pomoću Allahovih savršenih riječi, utječem se protiv zla svega što je stvorio.
translation.en: I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

title.bs: Dova pri sjedanju u prijevozno sredstvo

sayings.arabic: بِسْـمِ اللهِ وَالْحَمْـدُ لله، ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ * وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ﴾ الحَمْـدُ لله، الحَمْـدُ لله، الحَمْـدُ لله، اللهُ أكْـبَر، اللهُ أكْـبَر، اللهُ أكْـبَر، سُـبْحانَكَ اللّهُـمَّ إِنّي ظَلَـمْتُ نَفْسي فَاغْـفِرْ لي، فَإِنَّهُ لا يَغْفِـرُ الذُّنوبَ إِلاّ أَنْـت

transcription.bs: Bismillāh. El-ḥamdu lillāh. Subḥāne-l-leḏī seḫḫare lenā hāḏā ve mā kunnā lehū muqrinīne, ve innā ilā Rabbinā le munqalibūn. El-ḥamdu lillāhi, el-ḥamdu lillāhi, el-ḥamdu lillāhi. Allāhu ekber, Allāhu ekber, Allāhu ekber. Subḥānekellāhumme innī ẓalemtu nefsī, fa-gfir lī, fe innehu lā jagfiru-ḏ-ḏunūbe illā Ente.
transcription.en: Bismillāh, walḥamdulillāh. Subḥāna ‘lladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wa mā kunnā lahu muqrinīn. Wa innā ilā Rabbinā lamunqalibūn. Alḥamdulillāh, alḥamdulillāh, alḥamdulillāh, Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu Akbar, Subḥānaka ‘llāhumma innī ẓalamtu nafsī, faghfir lī, fa innahu lā yaghfirudh-dhunūba illā ant.

translation.bs: S Allahovim imenom (polazim). Hvala Allahu. Slavljen neka je Onaj Koji nam je ovo omogućio, sami to ne bismo bili sposobni. Mi se zaista Gospodaru našem vraćamo. Hvala Allahu, hvala Allahu, hvala Allahu. Allah je najveći, Allah je najveći, Allah je najveći. Neka si slavljen, Allahu. Zaista sam počinio nasilje prema sebi, zato mi oprosti. Jer, grijehe, zasigurno, ne oprašta niko drugi osim Tebe.
translation.en: With the Name of Allah. Praise is to Allah. Glory is to Him Who has provided this for us though we could never have had it by our efforts. Surely, unto our Lord, we are returning. Praise is to Allah. Praise is to Allah. Praise is to Allah. Allah is the Most Great. Allah is the Most Great. Allah is the Most Great. Glory is to You. O Allah, I have wronged my own soul. Forgive me, for surely none forgives sins but You.

title.bs: Dova pri ulasku u neko selo ili grad
title.en: Upon entering a town or village

sayings.arabic: أللّـهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّـمواتِ السّـبْعِ وَما أَظْلَلَـن، وَرَبَّ الأَراضيـنَ السّـبْعِ وَما أقْلَلْـن، وَرَبَّ الشَّيـاطينِ وَما أَضْلَلْـن، وَرَبَّ الرِّياحِ وَما ذَرَيْـن، أَسْـأَلُـكَ خَيْـرَ هذهِ الْقَـرْيَةِ وَخَيْـرَ أَهْلِـها، وَخَيْـرَ ما فيها، وَأَعـوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَـرِّها وَشَـرِّ أَهْلِـها، وَشَـرِّ ما فيها

transcription.bs: Allāhumme Rabbe-s-semāvāti-s-seb‘i ve mā aẓlelne ve Rabbe-l-ereḍīne-s-seb‘i ve mā aqlelne ve Rabbe-š-šejāṭīni ve mā aḍlelne ve Rabbe-r-rijāḥi ve mā ḏerejne: Es’eluke ḫajre hāḏihi-l-qarjeti ve ḫajre ehlihā ve ḫajre mā fīhā, ve e‘ūḏu bike min šerrihā ve šerri ehlihā, ve šerri mā fīhā.
transcription.en: Allāhumma Rabbas-samāwātis-sab`i wa mā aẓlaln, Wa Rabba ‘l-arāḍīnas-sab`i wa mā aqlaln, wa Rabbash-shayāṭīni wa mā aḍlaln, wa Rabbar-riyāḥi wa mā dharayn. As'aluka khayra hādhihi ‘l-qaryah, wa khayra ahlihā, wa khayra māfīhā, wa a`ūdhu bika min sharrihā, wa sharri ahlihā, wa sharri mā fīhā.

translation.bs: Allahu, Gospodaru sedam nebesa i onoga što ona natkriljuju, Gospodaru sedam Zemalja i onoga što one drže, Gospodaru šejtana i onog koga su oni zaveli, Gospodaru vjetrova i onoga što oni nose, molim Te za dobrobit ovoga naselja i za dobrobit njegovih žitelja, te za dobrobit svega što se u njemu nalazi. Tražim Tvoju zaštitu od zla ovoga naselja te od zla njegovih mještana i svega onoga što je u njemu.
translation.en: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all they overshadow, Lord of the seven worlds and all they uphold, Lord of the devils and all they lead astray, Lord of the winds and all they scatter. I ask You for the goodness of this town, and for the goodness of its people, and for the goodness it contains. I seek refuge in You from its evil, from the evil of its people, and from the evil it contains.

sayings.arabic: لا إلهَ إلاّ اللّه وحدَهُ لا شريكَ لهُ، لهُ المُلْـكُ ولهُ الحَمْـد، يُحْيـي وَيُميـتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لا يَمـوت، بِيَـدِهِ الْخَـيْرُ وَهوَ على كلّ شيءٍ قدير

transcription.bs: Lā ilāhe illellāhu vaḥdehū lā šerīke leh. Lehu-l-mulku ve lehu-l-ḥamdu, juḥji ve jumītu ve Huve Ḥajjun lā jemūtu. Bi jedihi-l-ḫajru ve Huve ‘alā kulli šej’in Qadīr.
transcription.en: Lā ilāha illallāh waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, Lahu ‘l-mulku wa lahu ‘l-ḥamd, Yuḥyī wa yumīt, wa huwa ḥayyun lā yamūt, Biyadihi ‘l-khayr, wa huwa `alā kulli shay'in Qadīr.

translation.bs: Nema boga osim Allaha, Jedinoga, Koji Sebi ravnog nema. Njemu pripada sva vlast i zahvalnost. On proživljava i usmrćuje, i On je Živi, Koji ne umire. U Njegovoj je ruci (On posjeduje) svako dobro i On nad svime ima moć.
translation.en: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise. He brings life and He causes death, and He is living and does not die. In His Hand is all good, and He is Able to do all things.

title.bs: Dova musafira za one koji ostaju

sayings.arabic: أَسْتَـوْدِعُكُـمُ اللَّهَ الَّذي لا تَضـيعُ وَدائِعُـه

transcription.bs: Estevdi‘ukumullāhe-l-leḏī lā teḍī‘u vedā’i‘uhū.
transcription.en: Astawdi`ukumu ‘llāha ‘l-ladhi lā taḍī`u wadā'i`uh.

translation.bs: Ostavljam vas u amanet (na čuvanje) Allahu, Čiji se amanet ne može izgubiti.
translation.en: I place you in the trust of Allah, whose trust is never misplaced.

sayings.arabic: أَسْتَـوْدِعُ اللَّهَ ديـنَكَ وَأَمانَتَـكَ، وَخَـواتيـمَ عَمَـلِك

transcription.bs: Estevdi‘ullāhe dīneke, ve emāneteke ve ḫavātime ‘amelike.
transcription.en: Astawdi`ullāha dīnak, wa amānatak, wa khawātīma `amalik.
