translation.bs: Allahu povjeravam vjeru tvoju, amanet (polog) tvoj i završetke djela tvojih.
translation.en: I leave your religion in the care of Allah, as well as your safety, and the last of your deeds.

title.bs: Dova kad posrne jahaća životinja ili pri problemu s prijevoznim sredstvom

sayings.arabic: بِسْـمِ اللهِ

transcription.bs: Bismillāh.
transcription.en: Bismillāh.

translation.bs: S Allahovim imenom.
translation.en: With the Name of Allah.

sayings.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ والنِّعْمَة لَكَ والمُلْكُ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ

transcription.bs: Lebbejke-llāhumme lebbejk, lebbejke lā šerīke leke lebbejke. Inne-l-ḥamde ven-ni‘mete leke ve-l-mulk, lā šerīke lek.
transcription.en: Labbayk-Allāhumma labbayk, labbayka lā sharīka laka labbayk, inna ‘l-ḥamda, wanni`mata, laka wa ‘l-mulk, lā sharīka lak.

translation.bs: Odazivam Ti se, Allahu moj, odazivam. Odazivam se Tebi, Koji ravnoga Sebi nemaš, odazivam. Doista, zahvalnost i sve blagodati pripadaju Tebi, kao i sva vlast. Ti Sebi nemaš ravnoga.
translation.en: I am here at Your service, O Allah, I am here at Your service. I am here at Your service, You have no partner, I am here at Your service. Surely the praise, and blessings are Yours, and the dominion. You have no partner.

title.bs: Dova prilikom boravka na Saffi i Mervi

sayings.arabic: إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ.

instructions.bs: Pri približavanju Saffi proučiti ovaj ajet:
instructions.en: This verse is recited when approaching Safa:

transcription.bs: Inne-ṣ-Ṣafā ve-l-Mervete min še‘ā’irillāh.
transcription.en: Innaṣ-Ṣafā wal-Marwata min sha‘ā’irillāh.

translation.bs: Safa i Merva su Allahova časna mjesta.
translation.en: Safa and Marwah are among the signs of Allah.

sayings.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ.

instructions.bs: Na Saffi se okrenuti prema Kibli i proučiti ovaj zikr 3 puta, a između ponavljanja uputiti vlastite dove. Isto učiniti na Mervi.
instructions.en: At Safa, this dhikr is recited 3 times while facing the Qiblah, with personal supplications between repetitions. The same is done at Marwah.

transcription.bs: Lā ilāhe illellāhu vallāhu ekber, lā ilāhe illellāhu vaḥdehū lā šerīke leh, lehu-l-mulku ve lehu-l-ḥamdu ve huve ‘alā kulli šej’in qadīr, lā ilāhe illellāhu vaḥdehū, endžeze va‘dehū ve neṣare ‘abdehū, ve hezeme-l-aḥzābe vaḥdehū.
transcription.en: Lā ilāha illallāhu wallāhu akbar. Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa ‘alā kulli shay’in qadīr. Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu, anjaza wa‘dahu wa naṣara ‘abdahu wa hazamal-aḥzāba waḥdah.

translation.bs: Nema boga osim Allaha i Allah je najveći. Nema boga osim Allaha, Jedinoga, Koji Sebi ravnoga nema. Njemu pripada sva vlast i zahvalnost i On je iznad svega. Nema boga osim Allaha, Jedinoga, Koji ispunjava Svoje obećanje i pomaže Svojem robu, i sve protivnike Sam porazi.
translation.en: There is no god but Allah, and Allah is greatest. There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. All dominion and praise are His, and He has power over all things. There is no god but Allah alone: He fulfilled His promise, helped His servant, and defeated the allied forces by Himself.

title.bs: Dova koja se uči između Jemenskog ugla Kabe i Crnoga kamena
title.en: Between the Yemeni corner and the black stone

sayings.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ

transcription.bs: Rabbenā ātinā fi-d-dun’jā ḥaseneten ve fi-l-āḫireti ḥaseneten ve qinā ‘aḏābe-n-nāri.
transcription.en: Rabbanā ātinā fid-dunyā ḥasanah wa fi ‘l-ākhirati ḥasanah wa qinā `adhāban-nār.

translation.bs: Gospodaru naš, daj nam dobro na ovome svijetu i dobro na drugome svijetu. Sačuvaj nas džehenemske vatre.
translation.en: Our Lord, grant us the good things in this world, and the good things in the next life, and save us from the punishment of the Fire.

sayings.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

transcription.bs: Lā ilāhe illellāhu vaḥdehū lā šerīke leh, lehu-l-mulku ve lehu-l-ḥamdu ve huve ‘alā kulli šej’in qadīr.
transcription.en: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa `alā kulli shay'in qadīr.

translation.bs: Nema boga osim Allaha, Jedinoga, Koji Sebi ravnoga nema. Njemu pripada sva vlast i zahvalnost. On nad svime ima moć.
translation.en: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah Alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is Able to do all things.

title.bs: Dova koja se uči na Muzdelifi

sayings.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ. لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

transcription.bs: Allāhu ekber. Lā ilāhe illellāhu vaḥdehū lā šerīke leh. Lehu-l-mulku ve lehu-l-ḥamdu ve Huve ‘alā kulli šej’in Qadīr.
transcription.en: Allāhu Akbar. Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa `alā kulli shay'in qadīr.

translation.bs: Allah je najveći. Nema boga osim Allaha, Jedinoga, Koji Sebi ravnoga nema. Njemu pripada sva vlast i zahvalnost. On nad svime ima moć.
translation.en: Allah is the Most Great. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah Alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is Able to do all things.

title.bs: Dova prilikom klanja životinje ili kurbana
title.en: When slaughtering or offering a sacrifice

sayings.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ [اللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ] اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي

transcription.bs: Bismillāhi vallāhu ekber. (Allāhumme minke ve leke.) Allāhumme teqabbel minnī.
transcription.en: Bismillāh wallāhu Akbar [Allāhumma minka wa lak] Allāhumma taqabbal minnī.

translation.bs: U ime Allaha, Allah je najveći. (Allahu moj, ovo je od Tebe i Tebi ga darujem.) Allahu moj, primi ovo od mene.
translation.en: With the Name of Allah, Allah is the Most Great! [O Allah, from You and to You.] O Allah, accept it from me.

sayings.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ

instructions.bs: Nakon počinjenog grijeha lijepo uzeti abdest, klanjati 2 rekata, pa zamoliti Allaha za oprost. U hadisu se navodi da Allah tada oprašta počinjeni grijeh.
instructions.en: After committing a sin, ablution is performed well, 2 rak‘ahs are offered, and Allah’s forgiveness is sought. The hadith states that Allah then forgives the sin.

transcription.bs: Estagfirullāh.
transcription.en: Astaghfirullāh.

translation.bs: Tražim oprost od Allaha.
translation.en: I seek Allah’s forgiveness.

sayings.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ

instructions.bs: Onome ko izgovori ovaj zikr Allah će oprostiti čak i ako je utekao sa bojnoga polja.
instructions.en: Whoever says this will be forgiven, even if they fled from the battlefield.

transcription.bs: Estagfirullāhe-l-leḏī lā ilāhe illā Huve-l-Ḥajju-l-Qajjūmu ve etūbu ilejhi.
transcription.en: Astaghfirullāha alladhī lā ilāha illā huwal-Ḥayyul-Qayyūmu wa atūbu ilayh.

translation.bs: Tražim oprosta od Allaha, osim Kojega drugoga boga nema, Živog i Postojanog Održavatelja, i Njemu se kajem.
translation.en: I seek forgiveness from Allah, besides Whom none is worthy of worship, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I turn to Him in repentance.

sayings.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ

transcription.bs: Rabbi innī limā enzelte ilejje min ḫajrin faqīr.
transcription.en: Rabbi innī limā anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqīr.

translation.bs: Gospodaru moj, meni je zaista potrebno svako dobro koje mi Ti spustiš.
translation.en: My Lord, I am truly in need of whatever good You send down to me.

sayings.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا

transcription.bs: Rabbi zidnī ‘ilmā.
transcription.en: Rabbi zidnī `ilmā.

translation.bs: Gospodaru moj, Ti znanje moje proširi!
translation.en: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

sayings.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِنْ لِسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي

transcription.bs: Rabbi-šraḥ lī ṣadrī, ve jessir lī emrī, vaḥlul ‘uqdeten min lisānī, jefqahū qavlī.
transcription.en: Rabbi-shraḥ lī ṣadrī, wa yassir lī amrī, waḥlul `uqdatan min lisānī, yafqahū qawlī.

translation.bs: Gospodaru moj, učini prostranim prsa moja, i olakšaj zadatak moj. Odriješi uzao s jezika mog, da bi razumjeli govor moj.
translation.en: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue that they may understand my speech.

title.bs: Dova za bogobojaznost, čednost i neovisnost
title.en: Supplication for piety, chastity and independence

sayings.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى

transcription.bs: Allāhumme innī es’eluke-l-hudā ve-t-tuqā ve-l-‘afāfe ve-l-ginā.
transcription.en: Allāhumma innī as’alukal-hudā wat-tuqā wal-‘afāfa wal-ghinā.

translation.bs: Allahu, molim Te za uputu, bogobojaznost, čednost i neovisnost!
translation.en: O Allah, indeed, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and sufficiency.

sayings.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ.

transcription.bs: Aṣbaḥnā ve aṣbeḥa-l-mulku lillāhi, ve-l-ḥamdu lillāhi, lā ilāhe illellāhu vaḥdehu lā šerīke leh. Lehu-l-mulku ve lehu-l-ḥamdu ve huve ‘alā kulli šej’in qadīr. Rabbi es’eluke ḫajre mā fī hāḏe-l-jevmi ve ḫajre mā ba‘dehū, ve e‘ūḏu bike min šerri hāḏe-l-jevmi ve šerri mā ba‘dehū. Rabbi e‘ūḏu bike mine-l-keseli ve sūi-l-kiber. Rabbi e‘ūḏu bike min ‘aḏābin fī-n-nāri ve ‘aḏābin fī-l-qabri.
transcription.en: Aṣbaḥnā wa aṣbaḥal-mulku lillāh, wal-ḥamdu lillāh, lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah. Lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa ‘alā kulli shay’in qadīr. Rabbi as’aluka khayra mā fī hādhal-yawmi wa khayra mā ba‘dahu, wa a‘ūdhu bika min sharri mā fī hādhal-yawmi wa sharri mā ba‘dahu. Rabbi a‘ūdhu bika minal-kasali wa sū’il-kibar. Rabbi a‘ūdhu bika min ‘adhābin fin-nāri wa ‘adhābin fil-qabr.

translation.bs: Jutro dočekasmo i jutro dočeka svekolika vlast Allahova. Hvala Allahu i nema boga osim Njega Jedinog, Koji druga nema. Njemu pripada sva vlast i svaka pohvala i on nad svačim ima moć. Allahu, molim Te za sva dobra ovog jutra i za dobra poslije njega. Gospodaru moj, Tebi se sklanjam pred lijenošću i zlohudom ohološću. Tebi se sklanjam pred kaznom Džehennema i kaburskom kaznom.
translation.en: We have entered the morning, and all sovereignty belongs to Allah; all praise is His. There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. Sovereignty and praise belong to Him, and He has power over all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the evils of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from punishment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.

sayings.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ، وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ، وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ.

transcription.bs: Emsejnā ve emse-l-mulku lillāhi, ve-l-ḥamdu lillāhi, lā ilāhe illellāhu vaḥdehu lā šerīke leh. Lehu-l-mulku ve lehu-l-ḥamdu ve huve ‘alā kulli šej’in qadīr. Rabbi es’eluke ḫajre mā fī hāḏihi-l-lejleti ve ḫajre mā ba‘dehā, ve e‘ūḏu bike min šerri hāḏihi-l-lejleti ve šerri mā ba‘dehā. Rabbi e‘ūḏu bike mine-l-keseli ve sūi-l-kiber. Rabbi e‘ūḏu bike min ‘aḏābin fī-n-nāri ve ‘aḏābin fī-l-qabri.
transcription.en: Amsaynā wa amsal-mulku lillāh, wal-ḥamdu lillāh, lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah. Lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa ‘alā kulli shay’in qadīr. Rabbi as’aluka khayra mā fī hādhihil-laylati wa khayra mā ba‘dahā, wa a‘ūdhu bika min sharri mā fī hādhihil-laylati wa sharri mā ba‘dahā. Rabbi a‘ūdhu bika minal-kasali wa sū’il-kibar. Rabbi a‘ūdhu bika min ‘adhābin fin-nāri wa ‘adhābin fil-qabr.

translation.bs: U noć uđosmo i noć dočeka svekolika Allahova vlast. Hvala Allahu i nema boga osim Njega Jedinog, Koji druga nema. Njemu pripada sva vlast i svaka pohvala i on nad svačim ima moć. Allahu, molim Te za sva dobra ove noći i za dobra poslije nje. Gospodaru moj, Tebi se sklanjam pred lijenošću i zlohudom ohološću. Tebi se sklanjam pred kaznom Džehennema i kaburskom kaznom.
translation.en: We have entered the evening, and all sovereignty belongs to Allah; all praise is His. There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. Sovereignty and praise belong to Him, and He has power over all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the evils of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from punishment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.

sayings.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ

instructions.bs: Pri kihanju izgovoriti:
instructions.en: Upon sneezing, these words are said:

transcription.bs: El-ḥamdu lillāhi.
transcription.en: Alḥamdulillāh.

translation.bs: Hvala Allahu.
translation.en: All praises and thanks are to Allah.

sayings.arabic: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ

instructions.bs: Kada neko kihne i zahvali Allahu, odgovoriti ovim riječima:
instructions.en: These words are said in response to someone who sneezes and praises Allah:

transcription.bs: Jerḥamukellāhu.
transcription.en: Yarḥamukallāh.

translation.bs: Allah ti se smilovao.
translation.en: May Allah have mercy upon you.

sayings.arabic: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ

instructions.bs: Nakon kihanja uzvratiti na odgovor druge osobe:
instructions.en: The person who sneezed then replies:

transcription.bs: Jehdīkumullāhu ve juṣliḥ bālekum.
transcription.en: Yahdīkumu ‘llāhu wa yuṣliḥu bālakum.

translation.bs: Allah te uputio i popravio tvoje stanje.
translation.en: May Allah guide you and set your affairs in order.

title.bs: Šta se izgovara kad nevjernik kihne
title.en: Reply to a non-Muslim who sneezes and praises Allah

sayings.arabic: يَهْـديكُـمُ اللهُ وَيُصْـلِحُ بالَـكُم

transcription.bs: Jehdīkumullāhu ve juṣliḥu bālekum.
transcription.en: Yahdīkumullāhu wa yuṣliḥu bālakum.

translation.bs: Allah vas uputio i popravio vaše stanje.
translation.en: May Allah guide you and set your affairs in order.

title.bs: Dova za onoga koga si grdio
title.en: For someone you have spoken ill of

sayings.arabic: اللَّهُم فأيما مؤمن سببته فاجعل ذلك له قربة إليك يوم القيامة

transcription.bs: Allāhumme fe-ejjumā mu’minin sebebtuhū fedž‘al ḏālike lehū qurbeten ilejke jevme-l-qijāmeti.
transcription.en: Allāhumma fa'ayyumā mu'minin sababtuhu faj`al dhālika lahu qurbatan ilayka yawma ‘l-qiyāmah.

translation.bs: Allahu, kojega god da sam vjernika grdio približi ga time Sebi na Sudnjem danu.
translation.en: O Allah, whomever of the believers I have abused, give him the reward of a sacrificial slaughter for it on the Day of Resurrection.

title.bs: Dova prilikom čuđenja ili radosnoga događaja
title.en: At amazement or a happy event

sayings.arabic: سُـبْحانَ الله

transcription.bs: Subḥānallāh.
transcription.en: Subḥānallāh.

translation.bs: Slavljen neka je Allah.
translation.en: Glory is to Allah.

sayings.arabic: لا إلهَ إلاّ اللّهُ

transcription.bs: Lā ilāhe illellāhu.
transcription.en: Lā ilāha illallāh.

translation.bs: Nema boga osim Allaha.
translation.en: There is none worthy of worship but Allah.

title.bs: Dova kada se dogodi nešto nepoželjno

sayings.arabic: قَدَّرَ اللَّهُ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ

instructions.bs: Kada se dogodi nešto nepoželjno, ne govoriti „Da je bilo ovako ili onako…”, nego proučiti ovu dovu.
instructions.en: When something unwelcome happens, this supplication is recited instead of saying, “If only things had been done differently…”.

transcription.bs: Qadderellāhu ve mā šā’e fe‘al.
transcription.en: Qaddarallāhu wa mā shā'a fa`al.

translation.bs: Allah je to odredio i, što je htio, učinio je.
translation.en: It is the Decree of Allah and He does whatever He wills.
